365blk.us.title: Lean on Me
365blk.us.description: In this fact-based film, a New Jersey superintendent, Dr. Frank Napier (Robert Guillaume), watches helplessly as East Side High becomes the lowest-ranked school in the state. With nowhere else to turn, Dr. Napier enlists maverick ex-teacher Joe Clark (Morgan Freeman) to take over as principal of the declining school. Unfortunately for Clark, before he can focus on improving the student body's state exam scores, he has to somehow rid the school of its gang and narcotics problems.

365blk.us.title: The Marva Collins Story
365blk.us.description: Marva Collins (Cicely Tyson) is a Chicago schoolteacher who strives to do her best to educate her students. However, she grows frustrated by the boundaries imposed on her methods by a failing public school system. Confronted by stubborn colleagues and a reproachful principal, Collins boldly decides to go it alone. Using her own funds, she creates the prep school for inner-city students that she feels they deserve. This moving biopic is based on a true story.

365blk.us.title: ATL
365blk.us.description: Four working-class teenagers live in an Atlanta neighborhood where hip-hop music rules and the coolest place to hang out is the local rollerskating rink. As the friends look forward to new horizons after high school, they face challenges on and off the rink that bring about turning points in their lives.

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's The Single Moms Club
365blk.us.description: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

365blk.us.title: Eve - Shelly And...
365blk.us.description: As Shelly starts making plans for the wedding, her mother, Beverly (Penny Johnson Jerald), visits and tries to convince her that marriage is a bad idea.

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - I Want My Z-TV
365blk.us.description: When Zaria (Reagan Gomez-Preston) decides to leave school after some success as a veejay, Robert (Robert Townsend) encourages her to stay.

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - An Affair to Forget
365blk.us.description: Robert's ex-girlfriend, now a pop star, announces that he was the inspiration for her award-winning album.

365blk.us.description: Things get tense when Jerri's (Suzanne Douglas) best friend (guest star Jennifer Lewis) blows into town and meddles in everything.

365blk.us.title: Roc - Joey Messes Up
365blk.us.description: Roc (Charles Dutton) pretends to be dating his brother's (Rocky Carroll) new girl because she recently broke up with Joey's friend.

365blk.us.title: Roc - 1992 Presidential Election
365blk.us.description: On Election Day morning, the Emerson family (Charles Dutton, Ella Joyce, Rocky Carroll, Carl Gordon) discusses the candidates and whether to vote.

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's Daddy's Little Girls
365blk.us.description: Monty (Idris Elba), a mechanic, struggles to make ends meet and raise his three young daughters alone. When his drug-dealing ex-wife wins custody of the girls in court, he enlists the help of Julia (Gabrielle Union), a successful attorney, to get the girls back. Romance unexpectedly blooms between the pair, but the couple must come to terms with their very different lives and find a way to keep Monty's family together.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E13 The Romans: All Roads Lead to Rome Barbara is sold as a slave and Ian is to be trained as a gladiator. The Doctor and Vicki arrive at the Emperor’s court with the Doctor still masquerading as Maximus Pettulian.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E14 The Romans: Conspiracy Poppaea plans to poison Barbara who has become the object of Nero’s affections. The Doctor is to be thrown to the lions, Ian and Delos are set against each other in the arena.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E15 The Romans: Inferno Inspired by the Doctor, Nero sets Rome ablaze. Ian must fight his way out of the arena and rescue Barbara. The Doctor and Vicki hurry to flee the city and escape to the TARDIS.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E12 The Romans: The Slave Traders After relaxing at a Roman villa the Doctor is mistaken for a murdered lyre player and targeted by an assassin. Meanwhile, Ian and Barbara are captured by slave traders.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E18 The Web Planet: Escape to Danger The alien intelligence, the Animus, coerces the Doctor to track down the invading Menoptra. Ian escapes the Carsinome and joins forces with Vrestin, but the Zarbi are in pursuit.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E20 The Web Planet: Invasion Barbara and a few of the Menoptra hide in an ancient temple. The Doctor and Vicki escape the Carsinome and join forces with Barbara’s group who are preparing to attack the Animus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E21 The Web Planet: The Centre The Menoptra attack the Carsinome and the Doctor and his friends come face-to-face with the Animus. The Isop-Top device is their only hope of destroying the alien creature.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E16 The Web Planet: The Web Planet The TARDIS is pulled down to the barren world of Vortis. The Doctor and Ian explore. Barbara falls under an hypnotic influence and is compelled to leave the safety of the TARDIS.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E17 The Web Planet: The Zarbi Rescued by the Menoptra, Barbara is then captured by the ant-like Zarbi. The Doctor and Ian trace the missing TARDIS to a giant web city and encounter a mysterious intelligence.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E27 The Space Museum: The Dimensions of Time Back on the proper time track, the travellers take steps to change the future. A rebel force of native Xerons are plotting against the invading Moroks who have captured the Doctor.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E29 The Space Museum: The Final Phase After forcing Lobos to revive the Doctor, Ian is also taken prisoner. The Xeron rebellion is underway whilst the fate of the Doctor and his friends still hangs in the balance.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Flavour Pioneers Buddy visits two culinary powerhouses who are bringing the flavours of their native countries to the places they now call home.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Pasta: The Stuff Of Life Sophie cooks orecchiette pasta at home and makes pasta with chickpeas for friends outdoors. She visits a pottery famous for its colourful pasta ceramics.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E10 Sydvestjylland, Denmark Tareq starts the next leg of his journey by visiting Sydvestjylland-a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Moa And More Chef Nornie ventures to the picturesque Moa Island, where she meets with Hans Awang. Together, they explore his lush garden brimming with fresh produce and the bountiful ocean at his doorstep.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E29 Kangaroo Island Around fourteen kilometres off the coast of South Australia lies a beautiful and unspoilt piece of land. Kangaroo Island is five hundred and nine kilometres of stunning and dramatic coastline.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E43 Episode 43 Laura is in the heart of South Australia's most famous wine region, the Barossa Valley, whipping up some family-friendly Cornflake Cookies. Chef Charlie Carrington shares the perfect vegan camp dish.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E13 Salsa Verde Chicken Tortilla Soup Rachael prepares a hearty, protein-packed Salsa Verde Chicken Tortilla Soup that's comforting, delicious, and filling. Meanwhile, John shakes up a refreshing 'White Wedding' cocktail?

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E5 Panetone It's Christmas time, and what better way to celebrate an Italian festive season than with the beloved panettone?

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Safety In Numbers It is Christmas, and Nigella is having a fabulous easy drinks party. On the menu there are meltingly tender turkey meatballs in tomato sauce and a must-have party recipe.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E38 Episode 38 of Season 9 The Prahran Market is buzzing with activity and Wendy from Stir the Pot is joining Laura to create one of her delightful recipes, a clever Potato Tart.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Summer Salad Jamie explains the history of pickling and preserving. If you have grown your own produce, you'll want to save it and keep it for as long as you can.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E67 Episode 67 We love it when Mrs. Schofield joins Justine in the kitchen!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E13 Food Culture Jung Eun Chae from Chae restaurant and Ukrainian chef Ivegen Klopotenko are in the kitchen with Adam, cooking with fermented ingredients.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Diana Chan's Malaysia
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Heritage Heritage visits Rumah Putih, experiences Rumah Makan Rendang Tok Yeop and cooks Pucuk Paku Masak Cili Api and Dendeng Daging.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Razzle Dazzle It's party time at Nigella's and this is one party that's full of fast, easy, delicious make in advance recipes and simple, achievable, last minute touches to make the food table and the party itself.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Piedmont Stanley Tucci visits the region that made the dream of unified Italy a reality. Piedmont boasts refined French heritage of the Middle Ages, and is now spearheading a slow food revolution.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Ishikawa In his wife's hometown, Adam Liaw uncovers the secrets to superb sake, samples some of the world's best sushi and prepares a classic Japanese dish with his mother-in-law.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie's Comfort Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Curried Fish Pie, Butter And Sage Gnudi And Hummingbird Cake Episode five sees Jamie and young son, Buddy, making a curried fish pie. Unlike a traditional fish pie, this Indian-inspired version has amazing perfumed layers of flavour and a crispy top.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Poh & Co. Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Episode 3 The delicious world of acclaimed cook, artist and lover of life Poh Ling Yeow, with a guide to some of her favourite dishes.

amc.us.title: Back to the Future Part II
amc.us.description: In this zany sequel, time-traveling duo Marty McFly and Dr. Emmett Brown return from saving Marty's future son from disaster, only to discover their own time transformed. In this nightmarish version of Hill Valley, Marty's father has been murdered and Biff Tannen, Marty's nemesis, has profited. After uncovering the secret to Biff's success -- a sports almanac from the future -- Marty and the Doc embark on a quest to repair the space-time continuum.

amc.us.title: Back to the Future
amc.us.description: In this 1980s sci-fi classic, small-town California teen Marty McFly is thrown back into the '50s when an experiment by his eccentric scientist friend Doc Brown goes awry. Traveling through time in a modified DeLorean car, Marty encounters young versions of his parents, and must make sure that they fall in love, or he'll cease to exist. Even more dauntingly, Marty has to return to his own time and save the life of Doc Brown.

amc.us.title: Back to the Future Part III
amc.us.description: In this final chapter, Marty McFly (Michael J. Fox) obtains a 70-year-old message from the time-traveling Dr. Emmett Brown (Christopher Lloyd), in which he informs Marty that he has retired to a small town in the Old West. Marty then finds out that the Doc was murdered shortly after sending the letter. In order to save his friend, Marty will have to travel back in time, disentangle a lovestruck Doc from a local schoolmarm, and repair the DeLorean -- all while avoiding a posse of gunslingers.

amc.us.title: Pretty in Pink

When one of the rich and popular kids at school, Blane, asks Andie out, it seems too good to be true. As Andie starts falling for Blane, she begins to realize that dating someone from a different social sphere is not easy.

amc.us.title: The Karate Kid
amc.us.description: Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves to Southern California with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), but quickly finds himself the target of a group of bullies who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself. Miyagi takes Daniel under his wing, training him in a more compassionate form of karate and preparing him to compete against the brutal Cobra Kai.

amc.us.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off

On Ferris' trail is high school principal Rooney (Jeffrey Jones), determined to catch him in the act.

antennatv.us.title: Designing Women
antennatv.us.description: Series creator Linda Bloodworth-Thomason uses the fictional Atlanta design firm of Sugarbaker and Associates as a witty bully pulpit for caustic social and political humor. The founder of the company is Julia Sugarbaker, a sharp-tongued but elegant and surprisingly compassionate woman. Her younger sister, Suzanne, is a former beauty queen who is long on charm but a bit slow on the uptake. Their associates are Mary Jo Shively, a recent divorcee, and officer manager Charlene Frazier, whose sweetness is matched only by her naivete. Their deliverman is Anthony Bouvier, a well-spoken ex-convict, and cheerfully dotty senior citizen Bernice Clifton often drops by for a visit as well.

bbcalba.uk.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
bbcalba.uk.description: 6/6. Tha na seòid a' feuchainn rud a-mach às an àbhaist 's a' dèanamh biadh bhèagan. The lads venture out of their comfort zone and go plant-based.

bbcalba.uk.title: SpeakGaelic
bbcalba.uk.description: 6/26. The studio guest is Iain MacPherson who hails from Alberta, Canada, and Calum Maclean visits a thriving community project in Glasgow.

bbcalba.uk.title: An Là
bbcalba.uk.description: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

bbcalba.uk.title: Port An Obain
bbcalba.uk.description: 2/6. In the village of Appin, Gregor MacCormick shows his collection of vintage engines, and retired sea captain Eric Smith visits the new lighthouse ship, the Pole Star.

bbcalba.uk.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
bbcalba.uk.description: 3/4. Daisy fights for survival, Joshua's family faces loss, and Méabh returns home. Contains some scenes which some viewers may find upsetting.

bbcalba.uk.title: Fraochy Bay
bbcalba.uk.description: 5/10. Zac has never settled into normal responsible adult life, and he wants one more chance at pop stardom. When opportunity knocks, he opens the door with both hands.

bbcalba.uk.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
bbcalba.uk.description: 9/12. Tha trèat sònraicht' aig abigail 'son lòn; Bagelean a tha soirbh an dèanamh. Abigail has a special lunch treat, easy-to-make bagels.

bbcalba.uk.title: Glan Fhèin
bbcalba.uk.description: 3/3. Angela clashes with angry locals shouting about short-term lets. Betty and Dido de-escalate things and share some home truths. Contains some strong language.

bbcalba.uk.title: An t-Uisge/Rain Stories
bbcalba.uk.description: 2/3. Rain's effect on our culture - including a frog wedding in India. Buaidh an uisge air ar cultar - a' gabhail a-steach banais eadar dà losgann sna h-Innseachan.

bbcalba.uk.title: Dàna | Europe's Wild Side
bbcalba.uk.description: 2/5. Coinneach Rankin explores Norway's Lofoten islands in search of world-class climbing and surfing within the Arctic Circle.

bbcamerica.us.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
bbcamerica.us.description: When the dolphin mascot of Miami's NFL team is abducted, Ace Ventura, a zany private investigator who specializes in finding missing animals, looks into the case. Soon Miami Dolphins players are kidnapped too, including star player Dan Marino, making Ace's sleuth work even more pressing. Working with Dolphins representative Melissa Robinson, Ace closes in on the culprits, but not before many ridiculous misadventures.

bbcamerica.us.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
bbcamerica.us.description: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Swept Away: A Very Special Episode
bbcamerica.us.description: When a murder happens on a reality television program, investigators try to identify the real culprits.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Bronx Cheer
bbcamerica.us.description: While investigating a murder, Briscoe and Green discover their prime suspect may be guilty of a homicide another man has been convicted of.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Ego
bbcamerica.us.description: A rising politician is suspected in the murder of a state investigator after Briscoe and Green discover he had a relationship with her.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - White Lie
bbcamerica.us.description: A drugs-and-money trail leads to a woman whose military husband directs anti-drug efforts in Colombia.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Whiplash
bbcamerica.us.description: A man's death is linked to a series of car crashes that finds the same employer, chiropractor, insurance adjuster and lawyers profiting.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - All My Children
bbcamerica.us.description: The murder of a prep school student points to a mystery woman who may have been extorting money from the victim's wealthy father.

bbcamerica.us.title: Eden: Untamed Planet - Luangwa: The Emerald Valley
bbcamerica.us.description: At the very end of East Africa's Great Rift Valley, there's a "land that time forgot"; the rolling grasslands of the Luangwa Valley.

bbcamerica.us.title: South Pacific - Ocean of Islands
bbcamerica.us.description: A closer look into the blue will reveal a scattering of islands, from the Tropics to the sub-Antarctic waters of the Southern Ocean.

bbcamerica.us.title: South Pacific - Castaways
bbcamerica.us.description: The ultimate castaways, from saltwater crocodiles and giant eels to crested iguanas, overcome great odds to reach islands thousands of miles apart.

bbcamerica.us.title: Snow Day
bbcamerica.us.description: Anything can happen on a snow day --- and for Hal and Natalie Brandston, it does. When the sun sets on this spectacular snow day will Hal be found cuddling with Claire? Will Natalie have succeeded in her quest for the coveted second snow day? Will parents everywhere pray for a heat wave?

bbcamerica.us.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
bbcamerica.us.description: When the dolphin mascot of Miami's NFL team is abducted, Ace Ventura, a zany private investigator who specializes in finding missing animals, looks into the case. Soon Miami Dolphins players are kidnapped too, including star player Dan Marino, making Ace's sleuth work even more pressing. Working with Dolphins representative Melissa Robinson, Ace closes in on the culprits, but not before many ridiculous misadventures.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Florida: America's Animal Paradise Florida is famous for its beaches, blue water and year-round sun, but it also has a surprising wild side; it is home to pine forests, coral reefs and the famous Everglades wetland, the largest subtropical wilderness in the U.S.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Last Grizzly of Paradise Valley Wildlife filmmaker Jeff Turner finds the Cascade Mountains under threat, especially its last grizzly bears.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Meerkats: Secrets of an Animal Superstar David Attenborough tells the story behind the world's most famous meerkat family.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Cast Adrift Stories of New Zealand's creatures and people, who rise to the challenges of their homeland.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Wild Extremes The story of New Zealand's wildest places and its most resilient pioneers.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 New Arrivals The story of New Zealand's wildlife and its changing fortunes since the arrival of humans.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 A Dangerous World Capuchin, giant otter and coatis babies take their first steps during a brief pause between seasonal extremes.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Facing the Flood The giant otters, coatis and capuchin monkeys have to learn how to survive as the river floods.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Enduring the Drought The monkeys, otters, coatis and jaguars battle to survive as drought and fires ravage the country.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Mountain Worlds The Serranías del Burro serves as a vital outpost for Mexico's black bears.

bbcearth.us.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Forests of the Maya The ancient temples of the Maya still tower over the forests of the Yucatán, where jaguars, monkeys and tropical birds make their home; it is a forest full of secrets, with a vast watery underworld.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Burning North A feature on the forces behind Mexico's driest region, and the animals overcoming its conditions.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild China
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Heart of the Dragon The landscapes of southern China, where rice is cultivated and a mysterious system of underground rivers is just beginning to be explored.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfour.uk.title: Voyage to Mars: The Longest Goodbye
bbcfour.uk.description: Film following Nasa psychologist Dr Al Holland as he prepares Mars-bound astronauts for the psychological demands of a three-year absence from Earth.

bbcfour.uk.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
bbcfour.uk.description: 2/3. The raw, early Earth had plenty of colour, but that canvas was about to be painted with a vast new palette - and the source of those colours was life. [S,AD,SL]

bbcfour.uk.title: Earth's Natural Wonders
bbcfour.uk.description: 3/3. A look at how people push themselves to the limit to survive in some natural wonders. We visit Brazil, Ethiopia, Laos, the Faroe Islands and the Swiss Alps. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: The Lost Neanderthals
bbcfour.uk.description: Scientists uncover the secrets of the Mandrin Cave in France, where the remains of a Neanderthal were found in 2015. Contains some scenes which some viewers may find upsetting.

bbcfour.uk.title: Jungle Animal Hospital
bbcfour.uk.description: Nature documentary. At the jungle animal hospital in Guatemala, the wards are full of exotic patients, many of them orphans rescued from the illegal pet trade.

bbcfour.uk.title: Dickens on Film - Arena
bbcfour.uk.description: An exploration of Charles Dickens's contribution to the history of film and television, using archive footage of classic and less familiar adaptations from 1898 to the present day. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: Sandy Welch Remembers... Our Mutual Friend
bbcfour.uk.description: Screenwriter Sandy Welch looks back on her 1998 adaptation of Dickens's Our Mutual Friend.

bbcfour.uk.title: Our Mutual Friend
bbcfour.uk.description: 1/4. The Boffins inherit a fortune when John Harmon, the only son and heir of their old employer, apparently drowns. A death brings Eugene Wrayburn into the life of Lizzie Hexam.

An insurer suspects a moped rider is engineering a crash for cash, while on Bristol's M32, a motorist cuts in and slams on the brakes, endangering the lives of other drivers.

bbconecaidgeshire.uk.description: It's a labour of love for two brothers, who create a wonderful home for their sister in Chesterton, while Martin is puzzled by a door going to nowhere in Plymouth and Dion follows a speedy flat renovation in Wales.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Dashcam Justice
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E12 A van overtakes a double-decker bus, then swerves towards a rider's horses to avoid an oncoming car. Her head camera captures the frightening near miss, and police uncover a surprising detail about the driver. An insurer suspects a moped rider is engineering a crash for cash, while on Bristol's M32, a motorist cuts in and slams on the brakes, endangering the lives of other drivers.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Homes Under the Hammer
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S27 Brotherly Love Two brothers renovate a property into a new home for their sister in Chesterton, Staffordshire and Martin Roberts is puzzled by a door going to nowhere in Plymouth. Dion Dublin follows a speedy flat renovation in Wales.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bargain Hunt
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S69 E19 Wetherby 19 Doctors and married couple Gareth and Linda compete against retailers Natalie and Steph at an antiques fair in Wetherby, West Yorkshire, with advice from experts Philip Serrell and Jonathan Pratt. Caroline Hawley keeps an eye on proceedings and also heads across to Leeds to admire a collection of miniature hats created by 19th-century hatter John Craig.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Doorbell Detectives
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E7 Matt Allwright hears from doorbell detective Ann, whose home was burgled in the night by two men while she was asleep upstairs. Plus, a teenage hero whose camera captured the moment he rescued an elderly lady from a burning building.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S26 E42 Cornwall Jules Hudson meets a couple who have spent a few decades in Australia, but have decided to swap the surf and sunshine for the lovely views and charm of Cornwall. He also visits an abandoned slate quarry that has been transformed into an extraordinary off-grid retreat, full of creativity and coastal magic.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 Glasgow - A Fix at the Top of the Cathedral Dominic Chinea and Lucia Scalisi help repair Glasgow Cathedral's weathervane at the top of the 225ft spire, save a Chinese unicorn mask made of bamboo and paper that plays and important part in celebrations for Glasgow's Hakka Chinese Community, and discover how street art is changing the city.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Finish Line
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E23 Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Philippa, Nathan, Pete, Natalie and Sandra race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Philippa, Nathan, Pete, Natalie and Sandra race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S31 E2 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E5 The penultimate leg through Australia sees a decisive Jeff and Matt risk an inland route to save funds for the final push, only to find themselves stranded in a remote town with no obvious connections. Princess and Junior choose to travel down the coast, but with their budget critically low they need to work as much as possible to make it to the final stage. Ella and Nana head to the shores of the largest sand island in the world, where Ella reflects on her recent heartbreak, and Sam and Kaz make a blunder that causes them precious time.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S19 E11 Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti are joined by South African chef Ash Valenzuela-Heeger, winner of the 2025 Michelin Young Chef Award, who sets the contestants the challenge of making barbecue beef sirloin, served with maitake mushrooms, caramelised roscoff onions and a cafe au lait sauce. The hopefuls then demonstrate their pastry knowledge as they serve up dessert.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MOTD: UEFA Champions League : 25/11/2026
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Action from the matchday five fixtures, including Club Brugge v Liverpool at Jan Breydel Stadium, Sporting Lisbon v Manchester United at Estádio José Alvalade and Arsenal v Borussia Dortmund at Emirates Stadium. Liverpool were looking to bounce back from a shock defeat at the hands of Fenerbahce in matchday four, while United will have wanted to build on a comeback against AS Roma, and Arsenal aimed to maintain their unbeaten record in this season's competition.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Michael McIntyre's The Wheel

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: La reyna del Pacífico
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Dos grandes carteles del narcotráfico están enfrascados en una pelea por territorios y una mujer tiene que encontrar la manera de acabar con el enfrentamiento.

cinemax.us.title: Catfish
cinemax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person.

cinemax.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemax.us.description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

cinemax.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemax.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

cinemax.us.title: Wonka
cinemax.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

cinemax.us.title: Hoot
cinemax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity.

cinemax.us.title: It
cinemax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (movie) - 1990

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (movie) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (movie) - 2023

cinemaxaction.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish.

cinemaxaction.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemaxaction.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemaxaction.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
cinemaxaction.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters!
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Man
cinemaxaction.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (movie) - 2005

cinemaxaction.us.title: Man Down
cinemaxaction.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (movie) - 2015

cinemaxaction.us.title: Open Water
cinemaxaction.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (movie) - 2003

cinemaxaction.us.title: Smoking Tigers
cinemaxaction.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends. (movie) - 2023

cinemaxaction.us.title: Nerve
cinemaxaction.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (movie) - 2016

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxaction.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Contagion
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Scream
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Fantastic Planet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other?

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Head Office
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Odd Jobs
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Repo Men
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Batman
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (movie) - 1989

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (movie) - 1995

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (movie) - 1997

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (movie) - 1999

cinemaxhits.us.title: Rampage
cinemaxhits.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Tomb Raider
cinemaxhits.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown.

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxhits.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen.

cinemaxhits.us.title: A Thousand Words
cinemaxhits.us.description: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner.

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Art of Getting By
cinemaxhits.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Time Bandits
cinemaxhits.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Colette
cinemaxhits.us.description: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century.

cinemaxhits.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
cinemaxhits.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
cinemaxhits.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxhits.us.title: Gimme Shelter
cinemaxhits.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (movie) - 1970

cinemaxhits.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
cinemaxhits.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era. (movie) - 2019

cinemaxhits.us.title: MacGruber
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxhits.us.title: Friendship
cinemaxhits.us.description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor. (movie) - 2025

cinemaxhits.us.title: Companion
cinemaxhits.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (movie) - 2025

cinemaxwest.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxwest.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Shut In
cinemaxwest.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Catfish
cinemaxwest.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person.

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemaxwest.us.description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxwest.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxwest.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxwest.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemaxwest.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

cinemaxwest.us.title: Wonka
cinemaxwest.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Hoot
cinemaxwest.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Sessions
cinemaxwest.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: It
cinemaxwest.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (movie) - 1990

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun
cinemaxwest.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (movie) - 2018

cinesony.us.title: Pineapple Express
cinesony.us.description: Dale Denton, cuyo trabajo es entregar citaciones legales, le compra marihuana a una mula que se llama Saúl. El traficante quiere hacerse amigo suyo, pero Dale solo está interesado en los negocios.

cinesony.us.title: Dragon Wars
cinesony.us.description: Ethan Kendrick (Jason Behr) descubre que unas criaturas antiguas llamadas Imoogi han regresado a la Tierra, y la única forma de detenerlas es con la ayuda de Sarah (Amanda Brooks). Basada en una leyenda coreana.

cinesony.us.title: Black Hawk Down
cinesony.us.description: En octubre de 1993, una unidad de élite del Ejército de Estados Unidos es enviada a Mogadiscio, la capital de Somalia, para realizar una misión en plena guerra civil. Sin embargo, lo que parecía ser una misión sencilla se convierte en una pesadilla.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Captain Phillips
cinesony.us.description: En el año 2009, un grupo de piratas somalíes secuestran un barco carguero estadounidense y toman como rehenes a la tripulación. Entre ellos está el capitán del navío, Richard Phillips.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Moon
cinesony.us.description: El astronauta Sam Bell vive aislado durante tres años en una excavación minera lunar. Poco antes de que llegue el reemplazo, mientras sufre dolores de cabeza y alucinaciones, Sam descubre la presencia de una versión más joven de sí mismo.

cinesony.us.title: Cold Comes the Night
cinesony.us.description: Un criminal que está sufriendo una rápida pérdida de visión decide raptar a la propietaria de un hotel y a su joven hija. Las necesita para que sean sus ojos y poder recuperar un maletín de dinero que está en manos de un peligroso policía corrupto.

cinevault.us.title: Obsessed
cinevault.us.description: Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear.

cinevault.us.title: It Could Happen to You
cinevault.us.description: Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

cinevault.us.title: Crazy in Alabama
cinevault.us.description: In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

cinevault.us.title: Stealing Harvard
cinevault.us.description: John (Jason Lee) is a hard-working guy who only wants to marry his longtime girlfriend Elaine (Leslie Mann). Elaine and John have vowed to marry once they save $30,000 for their dream house. Things are fine until John's sister calls to remind him of his promise to pay his niece's tuition, which costs $29,829 and is due in two weeks! John turns to his friend Duff (Tom Green) to help him make $30,000 quickly. Duff convinces John to make a short-term commitment to petty crime.

cinevault.us.title: Whatever It Takes
cinevault.us.description: A nerdy teen, Ryan Woodman (Shane West) is smitten with the popular and gorgeous Ashley Grant (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), who apparently has no interest in him. Meanwhile, dim star athlete Chris Campbell (James Franco) has his eye on Ryan's brainy and beautiful friend, Maggie Carter (Marla Sokoloff). The two agree to help each other in their romantic quests, but, as they come closer to their goals, both Ryan and Chris suspect that they might be pursuing the wrong girls.

cinevault.us.title: The Waterdance
cinevault.us.description: Injured in a climbing accident, writer Joel Garcia (Eric Stoltz) wakes up in a hospital having lost the use of his legs. Soon after, he's placed in a recovery ward where he begins the arduous process of rehabilitation and meets others with injuries like his own. Raymond (Wesley Snipes) is a ladies' man whose girl has nevertheless split, and Bloss (William Forsythe) is a rather prejudiced biker. Together, this unlikely trio helps one another to overcome the greatest challenge of their lives.

cinevault.us.title: Finding Graceland
cinevault.us.description: En route to Memphis, Tenn., on a solemn solo road trip, widower Byron Gruman picks up a disarming hitchhiker who claims to be the late, great Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife, Beatrice, in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland.

circlecountry.us.description: Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - The Stranger
circlecountry.us.description: As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Kate and the Manpower Problem
circlecountry.us.description: An old friend of Kate tells the girls to dig up some eligible prospects, in order to get Kate married again.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Ladybugs
circlecountry.us.description: Uncle Joe wants to cash in on the recent Beatlemania fever, by making up a girl group named The Ladybugs, starring his nieces and Sheriff Ragsdale's daughter.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Hooterville Flivverball
circlecountry.us.description: Uncle Jo plans to use Orville Miggs' flivver to power his own railroad and bankrupt the Hooterville Cannonball.

circlecountry.us.description: Saturday-night showcase of country-music stars performing their biggest hits at Nashville's famed Grand Ole Opry.

circlecountry.us.description: A woman (Jill Ireland) hires a bush pilot (Charles Bronson) to free her husband (Robert Duvall), framed for a murder, from a Mexican prison.

circlecountry.us.title: Violent City
circlecountry.us.description: A lone high-priced hit man (Charles Bronson) gets even with an underworld boss (Telly Savalas) to avenge a double cross.

circlecountry.us.title: Borderline
circlecountry.us.description: A U.S. Border Patrol officer (Charles Bronson) poses as an illegal alien to catch a killer (Ed Harris) smuggling laborers from Mexico.

circlecountry.us.title: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
circlecountry.us.description: Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.

circletv.us.title: Dark Star
circletv.us.description: Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

circletv.us.title: Death at Dawn
circletv.us.description: A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

circletv.us.title: The Great Filling Station Robbery
circletv.us.description: Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern technology to solve several burglaries at a filling station.

circletv.us.title: Andy Discovers America
circletv.us.description: Andy's knowledge of American history is put to the test by Opie and a new teacher.

classica.us.title: J. S. Bach - Weihnachtsoratorium, BWV 248
classica.us.description: Der Thomanerchor Leipzig und das Gewandhausorchester interpretieren Bachs Weihnachtsoratorium.

classica.us.title: Schumann - 3. Klaviersonate, Op. 14
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die dritte Klaviersonate, Op. 14 von Robert Schumann.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Novelletten, op. 21
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Novelletten, Op. 21. Die acht Stücke für Klavier, die diesen Liederzyklus ausmachen, werden oft einzeln aufgeführt. Es trägt eine Widmung an den Pianisten Adolph Henselt.

classica.us.title: Gara Garayev: Herbstsonaten
classica.us.description: Pianist Vadim Repin und Bratschist Murad Hüseynov interpretieren Gara Garayevs Bratschensonate und 24 Präludien für Klavier. Aufgenommen in La Grange au Lac. Geschrieben und inszeniert von Juliette Swierczewski und aufgenommen in La Grange au Lac. Obwohl Garayev ein Komponist des 20. Jahrhunderts ist, trägt seine Musik Anklänge an die romantische Musik. Murad, der Hauptakteur, verkörpert eine jener von Einsamkeit geprägten Figuren, die in den romantischen Gemälden von Friedrich zu finden sind.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartett Nr. 6, Op. 18, Nr. 6
classica.us.description: Das Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène feierte Beethovens 250. Geburtstag mit der Gesamtaufführung aller 16 Streichquartette. Die Aufzeichnung aus der Pariser Philharmonie zeugt von der intensiven Auseinandersetzung des Ensembles mit Beethovens Werk.

classica.us.title: Wer hat das Boléro von Maurice Ravel gestohlen?
classica.us.description: In der Dokumentation wird der Rechtsstreit um das Musikstück Boléro untersucht. Das Stück wird von Maurice Ravel im Jahr 1928 komponiert und dieser gibt die Rechte an seinen Bruder Edouard. Dieser stirbt 1960 und löst den Rechtsstreit aus.

classica.us.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20
classica.us.description: In der Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz die Humoreske in B-Dur, Op. 20. Schumann komponierte das Werk im Jahr 1839 und widmete es Julie von Webenau. Der Titel des Werks bezieht sich auf die ältere Bedeutung von Humor als emotionaler Zustand.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Mahler - 4. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Kirill Karabits dirigiert Gustav Mahlers 4. Sinfonie. Als Solistin tritt die Sopranistin Lucy Crowe auf. Seine Vierte Sinfonie beginnt mit Schellenklang, Vogelgezwitscher und einer Melodie, wie direkt aus Mozarts Welt. Alles wirkt wunderbar einfach.

classica.us.title: Hans van Manen: Moving to Music
classica.us.description: Reflexionen von Freunden und Kollegen, die Details der Choreographie von Hans van Manen enthüllen.

classica.us.title: Berlioz : Symphonie fantastique, op. 14
classica.us.description: Das Armenische Nationalphilharmonische Orchester führt Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14 auf. Dieses ist unter der Leitung von Dirigent Eduard Topchjan. Komponiert wurde das Stück von Hector Berlioz im Jahr 1830.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 1. Klavierkonzert, Op. 15
classica.us.description: Lars Vogt ist Solist in einer Aufführung von Beethovens erstem Klavierkonzert. Das Orchestre de Paris wird von Herbert Blomstedt dirigiert. Die Aufnahme entstand 2013 im Salle Pleyel in Paris.

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Sonate für Violin (BWV 1005)
classica.us.description: Isabelle Faust spielt zwei unglaubliche Solowerke für Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für Violine des Komponisten.

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. Im Jubiläumsjahr 2021 wurden sie im neu restaurierten Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses mit dem Collegium 1704 aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10
classica.us.description: Mahlers 10. Symphonie ist ein unvollendetes Werk, das der Komponist bei seinem Tod hinterließ und das seine letzte emotionale Reise von Qual und Herzschmerz zu einer vorbehaltlosen Akzeptanz des Lebens und der menschlichen Liebe darstellt.

classica.us.title: Galaxmphony - Die finale Odyssee
classica.us.description: Das DR Symphonieorchester sprengt die Schallmauer und entführt Sie in ferne Galaxien - an einen Ort, der zwischen Realität und Fantasie liegt, mit Soundtracks von Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune und vielen anderen.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt eine Aufführung von Schumanns "Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26".

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 2 in D-Dur, op. 36
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 2. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in D-Dur Op. 36, welche zum ersten Mal am 3. April 1803 aufgeführt wurde. Gezeigt wird eine Aufnahme aus dem Jahr 2014.

classica.us.title: Luisi dirigiert Mahler und Beethoven
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt ein Konzert geleitet von Fabio Luisi mit der Musik von Mahler und Beethoven.

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe.

classica.us.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Halloween Part I: Kim's Revenge
cleotv.us.description: Kim decides not to join Moesha and Niecy as the spandex-clad Divas of Soul after she hears the pair joking about her weight.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Rhythm and Dues
cleotv.us.description: Moesha (Brandy Norwood) gets her friends' record played on the radio, then finds herself in legal trouble. Guest star: Morris Day.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Doormat No More Episode
cleotv.us.description: When Dee Dee turns down Mona's request for a favor, Mona regrets telling her not to let people take advantage of her.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Who's Wooing Who? Episode
cleotv.us.description: When Mona is offered a different job at another record label, she must decide whether to stay or move on.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Mothers for Others Episode
cleotv.us.description: When Big Dee Dee crashes Phyllis' charity telethon meeting, Phyllis loses it and tells everyone that Big Dee Dee was pregnant before she married Charles.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Thorne in My Side Episode
cleotv.us.description: When Phyllis gets into trouble with her Homeowner's Association, Dee Dee defends her, but winds up causing more trouble.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Kill Switch
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tenn., by murdering young women, and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Killing Season

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The 51st State
