Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman

After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts.

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000.

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything.

Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant's past threatens to unravel their idyllic life. As Cam digs for answers, passion turns into paranoia, and a twisted game of lies and manipulation threatens to destroy everything she thought she knew.

He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Kitty Hallow Killer

When Mason and Jessica get into a horrible car accident on their wedding day, Jessica wakes up with no memory of her life or even her husband. As her memories start to come back in pieces, she is afraid that her husband, Mason, could be The Kitty Hallow Killer.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Cougar
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it's too late.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: The Good Sister
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin's life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

mgmplus.us.title: The Isolate Thief
mgmplus.us.description: One bitter-cold winter during the Civil War, a young woman becomes the lone caretaker of a remote Union Army outpost. When a stash of stolen gold falls into her lap, a gang of vicious outlaws comes looking for it. As they turn her home into a battleground, she must stay one step ahead of them in order to survive.

mgmplus.us.title: Rounders
mgmplus.us.description: Mike McDermott loses his money in a poker game against Russian gangster Teddy "KGB". Under pressure from his girlfriend, Jo, he promises to quit gambling. This lasts until his friend, Lester "Worm" Murphy, gets out of prison and needs to pay off an old debt. The pair come close to earning the money back but are caught cheating. Then Mike finds out the debt is owed to Teddy and makes one last-ditch effort to beat the Russian.

mgmplus.us.title: Double Jeopardy
mgmplus.us.description: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues.

mgmplus.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 6: A Princesa De Aveiro
mgmplus.us.description: Captive on Skeleton Island, Jim turns the tables in an attempt to catch up to Long John before he can leave with the treasure; back at sea, alliances fracture and reunite, binding the survivors together in a dangerous new partnership.

mgmplus.us.description: The crew is on the run once again; the Institute struggles after a setback; desperate, Luke makes a choice that may cost him everything he holds dear.

mgmplus.us.description: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

mgmplus.us.title: When Worlds Collide
mgmplus.us.description: After Dr. Bronson (Hayden Rorke) discovers Zyra, a new planet, fellow astronomer Dr. Hendron (Larry Keating) checks Bronson's data and reaches the horrifying conclusion that Bellus, a star in Zyra's orbit, is doomed to crash into the Earth within a matter of months. Meanwhile, Hendron's daughter, Joyce (Barbara Rush), has grown fond of pilot David Randall (Richard Derr), and pleads to have him brought along as a small group is relocated to Zyra to avoid the impending mass destruction.

mgmplus.us.title: Raging Bull
mgmplus.us.description: The story of a middleweight boxer as he rises through ranks to earn his first shot at the middleweight crown. He falls in love with a gorgeous girl from the Bronx. The inability to express his feelings enters into the ring and eventually takes over his life. He eventually is sent into a downward spiral that costs him everything.

mgmplus.us.title: Saint Maud

mgmplus.us.title: From Beyond
mgmplus.us.description: Obsessive scientist Dr. Pretorius (Ted Sorel) successfully discovers a way to access a parallel universe of pleasure by tapping into the brain's pineal gland. When he is seemingly killed by forces from this other dimension, his assistant, Dr. Crawford Tillinghast (Jeffrey Combs), is accused of the murder. After psychiatrist Katherine McMichaels (Barbara Crampton) and detective Bubba Brownlee (Ken Foree) take the case, the trio risks a return to the other world in order to solve the mystery.

mgmplus.us.title: The Believers
mgmplus.us.description: Recently widowed psychiatrist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) has just moved back to New York City with his young son, Chris (Harley Cross), in an attempt to start over after his wife's horrific accidental death. Cal takes an assignment helping the police with the investigation of a cult-like and bizarre ritualistic double murder. As Cal gets closer to the truth, he realizes that he and those close to him may be the target of supernatural and deadly forces, and that the enemy is closer than he knows. (movie) - 1987

mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Intent on drinking himself to death, a man (Nicolas Cage) who has lost everything finds solace with a Las Vegas hooker (Elisabeth Shue).

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Children of a Lesser God
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Starting his new job as an instructor at a New England school for the deaf, James Leeds meets Sarah Norman, a young deaf woman who works at the school as a member of the custodial staff.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Flashbacks tell the story of a tenderfoot who rose to glory by gunning down the outlaw terrorizing his small town.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: To Catch a Thief
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A retired cat burglar (Cary Grant) sees fireworks with an American heiress (Grace Kelly) on the Riviera.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Mouse Hunt
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Brothers (Nathan Lane, Lee Evans) inherit a dilapidated mansion inhabited by a resourceful rodent that refuses to leave.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Siblings (Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger) learn that magical creatures are behind the strange occurrences at their great-great-uncle's rundown estate.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2001-06-29

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Rain Man
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives. (Drama, Movie) - 1988-12-12

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Uninvited
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Mystery) - 2009-01-30

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Below
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: The submarine U.S.S. Manta had a perfect record until the mysterious death of its captain. The next-in-command, Lt. Richard Brice (Bruce Greenwood) is determined to steer his disheartened crew back to safety. But after three battle survivors board the sub, bizarre and frightening things begin to happen. As the tale unfolds, and crew members begin to disappear, Ensign Douglas O'Dell (Matthew Davis) must piece together the puzzles of the submarine's past before it is too late to resurface alive. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2002-10-11

mgmplushits.us.title: Secret Service
mgmplushits.us.description: MI6 agent Kate Henderson uncovers an audacious plot involving Russia and an asset in the UK Cabinet; Kate's hunt for the mole puts her agent's life at risk.

mgmplushits.us.title: Barbershop
mgmplushits.us.description: A smart comedy about a day in the life of a barbershop on the south side of Chicago. Calvin (Ice Cube), who inherited the struggling business from his deceased father, views the shop as nothing but a burden and a waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy and struggles with the notion that he just sold it out.

mgmplushits.us.title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
mgmplushits.us.description: This sequel to the 2002 film returns to the Chicago barbershop owned by Calvin Palmer Jr. (Ice Cube). His employees -- Isaac (Troy Garity), Terri (Eve), Ricky (Michael Ealy), Dinka (Leonard Earl Howze) and Kenard -- have their own personal and workplace problems, and a new barbershop called Nappy Cutz has moved in across the street. As Calvin tries to change the character of his business, Nappy Cutz and gentrification become a threat to the surrounding community.

mgmplushits.us.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
mgmplushits.us.description: To survive harsh economic times, Calvin and Angie have merged the barbershop and beauty salon into one business. The days of male bonding are gone as Eddie and the crew must now contend with sassy female co-workers and spirited clientele. As the battle of the sexes rages on, a different kind of conflict has taken over Chicago. Crime and gangs are on the rise, leaving Calvin worried about the fate of his son. Together, the friends come up with a bold plan to take back their beloved neighborhood.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Professionals
mgmplushits.us.description: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band whether they should honor their agreement.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Passenger
mgmplushits.us.description: Randy is perfectly content to fade into the background, but when one of his co-workers goes on a sudden and violent rampage, he must face his fears and confront his troubled past to survive.

mgmplushits.us.title: Hondo
mgmplushits.us.description: An embittered Indian scout attempts to escort a homesteader's wife and her son back to safety after her cowardly husband deserts her during an Apache attack. When she refuses to go, the scout stays on to help for a while and, over time, forms a strong bond with both her and her son.

mgmplushits.us.title: Suburbicon
mgmplushits.us.description: Suburbicon is a peaceful, idyllic, suburban community with affordable homes and manicured lawns -- the perfect place to raise a family, and in the summer of 1959, the Lodge family is doing just that. But the tranquil surface masks a disturbing reality, as husband and father Gardner Lodge must navigate the town's dark underbelly of betrayal, deceit and violence.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
mgmplushits.us.description: In the Southwest during the Civil War, a mysterious stranger, Joe (Clint Eastwood), and a Mexican outlaw, Tuco (Eli Wallach), form an uneasy partnership -- Joe turns in the bandit for the reward money, then rescues him just as he is being hanged. When Joe's shot at the noose goes awry during one escapade, a furious Tuco tries to have him murdered. The men re-team abruptly, however, to beat out a sadistic criminal and the Union army and find $20,000 that a soldier has buried in the desert.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Dictator
mgmplushits.us.description: Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule. (movie) - 2012

mgmplushits.us.title: Kingpin
mgmplushits.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (movie) - 1996

mgmplushits.us.title: The Stepford Wives
mgmplushits.us.description: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. (movie) - 2004

mgmplushits.us.title: Bulletproof Monk
mgmplushits.us.description: For 60 years, a mysterious monk with no name has zigzagged the globe to protect an ancient scroll -- a scroll that holds the key to unlimited power. Now the Monk must look for a new scroll keeper. Kar is an unlikely candidate, a streetwise young man whose only interest is himself. But when he inadvertently saves the Bulletproof Monk from capture, the two become partners in a scheme to save the world from the scroll's most avid pursuer. (movie) - 2003

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Harlem Nights
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy).

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Con artist Lawrence Jamieson (Michael Caine) is a longtime resident of a luxurious coastal resort, where he enjoys the fruits of his deceptions -- that is, until a competitor, Freddy Benson (Steve Martin), shows up. When the new guy's lowbrow tactics impinge on his own work, Jamieson resolves to get rid of him. Confident of his own duplicitous talents, Jamieson challenges Benson to a winner-takes-all competition: whoever swindles their latest mark first can stay, while the other must leave town.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Bandits
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Joe (Bruce Willis) and Terry (Billy Bob Thornton) have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new -- and somewhat legitimate -- life south of the border. Unfortunately, things get more complicated when they meet Kate Wheeler (Cate Blanchett), who runs into Terry with her car. Kate joins the bandits on their cross-country spree, and eventually she steals something, too: their hearts.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: A Fish Called Wanda
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: British gangster George Thomason (Tom Georgeson) and his hapless aide, Ken Pile (Michael Palin), draft a pair of arrogant Americans, grifter Wanda Gerschwitz (Jamie Lee Curtis) and weapons expert Otto West (Kevin Kline), for a massive diamond heist. When the job goes badly, Wanda attempts to seduce George's stuffy lawyer, Archie Leach (John Cleese), to find out where George hid the diamonds. Meanwhile, Ken repeatedly attempts to kill an elderly woman (Patricia Hayes) who witnessed the robbery.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Big Country
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Retiring to the American West to marry his fiancée, Patricia Terrill (Carroll Baker), Captain James McKay (Gregory Peck) enters a land-and-water feud between his future father-in-law, Major Terrill (Charles Bickford), and the rough and lawless Hannassey family, led by Rufus (Burl Ives). McKay prefers peace between himself and the Hannasseys, who repeatedly attempt to provoke violence. But his steadfast demeanor only angers his fiancée and Major Terrill, who won't settle for truces.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Henry V
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In this gritty screen adaptation of Shakespeare's play about the heroic and ruthless king, Henry V of England (Kenneth Branagh) determines to lay claim to the kingdom of France. Henry's self-doubt and the diminished morale of his army stand in the way of a victory that would unite the two countries and provide Henry with a queen (Emma Thompson). However, his sheer determination and his impassioned speeches ready his men for the bloodiest of battles -- Agincourt.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Men at Work
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Carl Taylor (Charlie Sheen) and James St. James (Emilio Estevez) are garbage men who spend their workdays goofing around and disrupting the quiet on the streets of their town. But their good-natured fun comes to an abrupt halt when they discover a local politician's corpse in one of their cans. Determined that this is their chance to be more than trash collectors, this snarky pair of amateur detectives decide to solve the case on their own and so become entangled in a toxic waste cover-up.

mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. (movie) - 1996

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Worldbreaker
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he equips her for survival and the battles ahead. (movie) - 2025

mgmpresentsaction.us.description: As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: No Way Out
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Package
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Death Wish II
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back – with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Death Wish 3
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Dark Half
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Amityville Horror (1979)
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: James Brolin, Margot Kidder and Rod Steiger star in this horror classic as George and Kathy Lutz (Brolin, Kidder) buy their dream home only for it to becomes a hellish nightmare as satanic forces haunt them with sheer, unbridled evil!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Amityville 3-D
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: The home of unspeakable evil is back! Tony Roberts, Tess Harper, Robert Joy, Candy Clark and Meg Ryan star in this third outing to Amityville in which a skeptical journalist sets out to debunk the Amityville house's reputation for unspeakable evil.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Theater Of Blood
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Vincent Price is a crazed Shakespearean actor who adds murder to his repertoire when he takes gruesome revenge on the critics who slighted him.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Dr. Phibes Rises Again!
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: The eminent Dr. Phibes (Vincent Price) awakens from a decade of suspended animation and heads to Egypt with the corpse of his dead wife. Which he intends to resurrect by murdering people in strange and heinous ways to invoke a magical incantation!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Donovan's Brain
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its ownand is controlling him through telepathic messages!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Count Yorga, Vampire
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they’re outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Hour of the Gun
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Wyatt Earp (James Garner) deputizes Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) and forms a posse to hunt Ike Clanton (Robert Ryan) and his gang.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Doc
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Doc Holliday (Stacy Keach), Kate Elder (Faye Dunaway) and Wyatt Earp (Harris Yulin) hang out in Tombstone before the shootout at the OK corral.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Long Riders
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: The Jesse James-Cole Younger gang leaves a trail of emptied banks, plundered stagecoaches and dead bodies in its wake.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Young Billy Young
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: An old marshal (Robert Mitchum) finally faces his son's killer, joined by an outlaw (Robert Walker) who becomes his deputy.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Wonderful Country
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A Mexican-raised gunman (Robert Mitchum) romances an Army major's (Gary Merrill) wife (Julie London) while trying to run guns on the Texas border.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Man With the Gun
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A hired gun (Robert Mitchum) saves a cow town from a land-grabber and wins back his wife (Jan Sterling).

mlbnetwork.us.description: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Custom Carolina

movieplex.us.title: Face the Music
movieplex.us.description: Lisa (Molly Ringwald) and Charlie Hunter (Patrick Dempsey) are an award-winning songwriting team -- that is, until the demise of their marriage ends their musical partnership. With divorce proceedings underway and Charlie already attached to a hot young girlfriend, it doesn't seem like they'll have a change of heart anytime soon. But, when a French movie producer makes them a lucrative offer to write a love song, they're forced to collaborate -- and bicker -- once more.

movieplex.us.title: Jericho
movieplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

movieplex.us.title: Bernie the Dolphin

Sonic teams up with his own sidekick, Tails, and together they embark on a globe-trotting journey to find the emerald before it falls into the wrong hands.

Leaving the familiar confines of Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob and Patrick venture out towards Shell City, where they hope to find Neptune's crown, but numerous obstacles stand (or float) in their way. (movie) - 2004

nflnetwork.us.title: Good Morning Football ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
nflnetwork.us.description: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clouds
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - In The Future
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a sleepover at the Sheep's house, Peppa and Suzy sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they are grown up.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Creepy Crawly Safari
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mandy Mouse
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Apple Tree
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grownup Playground
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa spots a new playground! The children race over to it and discover that it's rather odd. Grampy Rabbit explains, this isn't a playground - it's an exercise park.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jigsaw Festival
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival - a jigsaw festival! Peppa is amazed by all of the completed jigsaws around the festival.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Detective Potato
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Daddy's car goes missing it's up to Detective Potato to find it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mountain Climbing
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends learn about climbing from Grampy Rabbit at the climbing centre. Mummy Pig is worried about George when he gets scared of heights.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Funny Music
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cushion Den
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Adventure Caravan
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Takeaway
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Biggest Muddy Puddle In The World
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bedtime
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have one more game of jumping up and down in muddy puddles before bedtime.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rebecca Rabbit
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George visit Rebecca Rabbit's house today. Rebecca's house is a bit different to Peppa's house - it is inside a hill! And instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Boat Pond
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends play with their toy boats at the pond.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Fish Pond
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to see a fish pond he used to visit when he was a little piggy.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cleaning the Car
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The family car is very muddy. Peppa and George have lots of fun helping Mummy and Daddy clean it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pedro's Cough
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children quickly catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Freddy Fox
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull's New Road
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Teddy's Day Out
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic, and Zoe Zebra has to rescue him.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Baby Piggy
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George meet their new cousin, a tiny baby piggy called Alexander.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cold Winter's Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is a very cold winter day. Peppa and George are wearing their hats, scarves, mittens and coats. They want to jump in muddy puddles, but the puddles are all frozen and slippery.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mirrors
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has fun looking at himself in the mirror and tries to find other shiny things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Shoes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never, ever wants to take them off - until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gardening
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Pig's Chickens
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bat and Ball
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play Bat and Ball, but when it is her turn she hits the ball too far.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hot Dry Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are playing in their pool. They help the garden animals cool down but when it rains, the animals are happy and so is Peppa. Rain makes muddy puddles for jumping in.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Broken Party Bus
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken bus. This is a job for Grampy Rabbit! Once fixed, Mummy Rabbit and Rebecca Rabbit arrive with a cake for Grampy Rabbit's birthday.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sibling School
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School, and learn about what to expect when the baby arrives.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Big Announcement
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George. However, Peppa and George struggle to wait patiently, so resort to playing games.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Science Museum
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her play group are visiting the museum. But not just any museum - it's the Science Museum, where there are lots of buttons to push and things to try out.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George's visit a restaurant, where they have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Calling Kylie
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn it's not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the earth.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Roof Top Garden
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and family come to help make a garden on the roof of the apartments. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Holding the Baby
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The nurse visits, and she decides that today's visit should be all about how to hold a baby. The nurse shows Peppa a special way for a small person to safely hold a baby.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Dinosaurs Alive!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard! The children all believe it's a dinosaur.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Sandcastle
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is a lovely, sunny day. Peppa and George have come to the seaside. It's a perfect time for everyone to make sandcastles, with a moat, a bridge, and a visitor.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bird Spotting
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George go birdwatching with Grandpa Pig. Grandpa really wants to see a cuckoo, then he hears one calling.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Water Park
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are going to the Water Park. Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park but first you need to put on your swimsuit.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Walking Bus
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children must walk to school in a walking bus! Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Party Bus
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa receives an invite to Candy Cat's birthday party - on a double decker bus.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Potty Training
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, Suzy Sheep, Mummy and Daddy help George understand what a potty is and how to avoid accidents. George gains confidence.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Penny Polar Bear's Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party! The children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They have great fun learning to play.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sea Treasure
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it. Who is it from.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playgroup Garden
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Singing Lesson
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson, helped by Mummy Rhino on the piano. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Biggest Picture in the World
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques - and even a paint cannon.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bigger House
nickjrtoo.uk.description: With a new baby on the way, Mummy and Daddy Pig realise they have run out of space at home! They decide to make their own home bigger with an extension.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Potato's Fruit & Vegetable Quiz
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Potato visits the school to talk about fruit and vegetables. But which team will win his quiz.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Ballet Lesson
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson. Peppa loves dancing. Everyone loves dancing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Dinosaur is Lost
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has the best birthday ever, including a visit to the Dinosaur Museum.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Champion Daddy Pig
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper, until everyone helps him train to win it back.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Emily Elephant
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa meets her new playschool friend Emily Elephant.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Painting
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have fun making potato prints and painting a lovely picture of a cherry tree.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Suzy Goes Away
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Sandpit
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are building a desert island, in the sandpit. They add a forest, a lake, houses, and shops. It's all going very well until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George play at being pretty butterflies, wriggly worms and muddy frogs.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Piggy in the Middle
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George play piggy-in-the-middle. George catches the ball with a little help from Daddy Pig.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Danny's Pirate Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig, the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Baby Alexander
nickjrtoo.uk.description: What's that sound? Is it a car alarm? Is it a fire engine? No, it's Baby Alexander. Babies cry a lot - but Alexander likes listening to Peppa. She knows about all sorts of things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Shadows
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George notice they have shadows, and no matter how fast they walk, run, or jump - they can't lose them.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Nursery Rhymes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their best nursery rhymes with each other.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playgroup Star
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa gets her very first Playgroup Star in school for drawing a wonderful picture of her house.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Castle
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen and even meet a dragon. It's George's favourite day ever.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Carnival
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The Carnival has come to town and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting people and floats.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Playground
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa gets stuck in the tyre on the climbing frame, and Daddy Pig gets stuck on the slide.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Simple Science
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While the playground is getting rebuilt, Daddy Pig teaches the children some simple science.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Molly Mole
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Madame Gazelle's House
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle and her wonky house.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Time Capsule
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends make a time capsule and bury it in the school garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Dentist
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr. Elephant the Dentist says that Peppa and George both have lovely clean teeth.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Train To The Rescue
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit's train has broken down with a carriage full of passengers who need to get to work. Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train Gertrude.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rescuing Miss Rabbit!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Baby Names
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is given the very important task of suggesting names for the new baby. She thinks of all sorts of names, but they aren't quite right.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Larenzo Lion
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today, Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Larenzo Lion who lives there! Larenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Martial Arts
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and how to take the right stance.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull Digs Up The River
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They see Mr. Bull, who's using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Doctor Hamster's Big Present
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit that she wants to exercise more, he builds something special to help her.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hoops
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the gar-den and together they learn to hop, skip and jump.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Miss Rabbit's Relaxation Class
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Cat's Cafe
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Cafe. Candy show Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Racquet Games
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere! So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cardboard Boxes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is at Suzy's house and there is a pile of cardboard boxes so, they take them outside to play with. Peppa turns the boxes into a cardboard shop, a spaceship and even a hospital.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Electric Car
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa's family squeeze into the new car that Daddy Pig is trying out for fun.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Stone Age Granny
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and her friends historical re-enactment society are being cave people. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a mammoth.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Marble Run
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig causes chaos when he improves Rebecca and Richard Rabbit's marble run game and the marble rolls into the lounge.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New TV
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and family are watching TV. until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything. but it doesn't beat their old TV.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Caravan Friends
nickjrtoo.uk.description: After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car! Luckily, the bear family stop it just in time.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep's Art Van
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hippies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a historical re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Looking for Things
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig is baking an apple pie, so Daddy Pig suggests Peppa and George play a game of looking for things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bat and Ball
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play Bat and Ball, but when it is her turn she hits the ball too far.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are playing in their pool. They help the garden animals cool down but when it rains, the animals are happy and so is Peppa. Rain makes muddy puddles for jumping in.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George. However, Peppa and George struggle to wait patiently, so resort to playing games.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's Balloon
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George gets a dinosaur balloon, but keeping hold of it proves difficult. Who will save George's balloon from flying off to the moon.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - My Cousin Chloe
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa's big cousin Chloe is coming to visit. Peppa is used to playing games by her own rules, but she finds that she has met her match in Chloe.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Paper Aeroplanes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing - because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Balloon Ride
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family win a trip on Miss Rabbit's hot air balloon, but get stuck in a tree in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Madame Gazelle's Leaving Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle announces that she is leaving the playgroup. The children are very sad to lose their favourite teacher, so they decide to throw her a leaving party.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Greenhouse
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig and Grandpa Dog are showing and sharing their lovely, tomato filled, Greenhouses to Peppa and George.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Long Train Journey
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Perfume
nickjrtoo.uk.description: After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Flying a Kite
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George and Daddy Pig discover that it's not very easy to fly a kite on a windy day.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Playgroup
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is George's first day at Peppa's playgroup. He paints a very good picture and everyone thinks he's brilliant - including Peppa.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Teddy Playgroup
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa brings home a teddy from Playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he won't have a very exciting time.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Miss Rabbit's Helicopter
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to escape all the fun - but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Horsey Twinkle Toes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Zebra delivers a parcel for Peppa and George from their Auntie Dottie. What could it be.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jumble Sale
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa helps raise the money for a new school roof at Madame Gazelle's jumble sale.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Hovercraft
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit saves the day when Grandpa Pig's boat sinks and drives everyone around on his Hovercraft.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Aquarium
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish surely Peppa can find a new friend for Goldie.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Daddy Gets Fit
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig loves to watch TV, but Peppa thinks that Daddy is not very fit and needs to do some exercise. Daddy Pig disagrees, but says that Peppa can help.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Chloe's Puppet Show
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig, and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre and she puts on a very funny puppet show with Peppa and George.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Richard Rabbit Comes To Play
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep comes to play with Peppa. The little boys don't want to play the same games as Peppa and Suzy.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pancakes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When it comes to pancake making, Daddy Pig thinks he is a bit of an expert. But he has a tendency to flip the pancakes a bit too high.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's New Clothes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand new clothes.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Windy Autumn Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa discovers that even "boring, dry leaves" can be fun when you jump up and down in them.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George go ice skating for the first time. Peppa finds it is quite difficult not to fall over.

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

pixl.us.description: This Biblical story of Jesus Christ is told through the eyes of the Virgin Mary (Pernilla August). Raised in Nazareth, Mary is betrothed to Joseph (David Threlfall) when the angel Gabriel appears to her, announcing that she is chosen to give birth to the messianic son of God, who will be conceived by the Holy Spirit. During a journey to Bethlehem for a Roman census, Mary gives birth to Jesus (Christian Bale), and later is witness to her son's miracles, as well as his persecution and crucifixion.

retroplex.us.title: Flaming Bullets
retroplex.us.description: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

retroplex.us.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
retroplex.us.description: Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and a couple of his Rough Rider buddies -- Rusty (Raymond Hatton) and Tommy (Eddie Acuff) -- join the Border Patrol. First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads.

retroplex.us.title: Stars Over Texas
retroplex.us.description: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

retroplex.us.title: Driftin' River
retroplex.us.description: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help.

retroplex.us.title: Return of the Lash
retroplex.us.description: Cheyenne Davis (Lash La Rue) comes to the rescue of a group of ranchers who are losing their homes to a gang of malicious outlaws. When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

retroplex.us.title: Riders of Destiny
retroplex.us.description: Loner government agent Singin' Sandy Saunders (John Wayne) witnesses what seems to be a stagecoach robbery, committed by young Fay Denton (Cecelia Parker). But Fay is actually just trying to get her hands back on her own money in order to keep it from thieving stooges Bert (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) and Elmer (Heinie Conklin) and their boss, local land grabber James Kincaid (Forrest Taylor). Saunders then teams up with Kay to fight off the gang and derail the criminal plots of the greedy Kincaid.

retroplex.us.title: Stage to Mesa City
retroplex.us.description: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

retroplex.us.title: Blue Steel

sbsbrisbane.au.title: BBC News At Ten
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The latest national and international news stories from the BBC News team from London, UK, in English.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: France 24 International Sbs Midday
sbsbrisbane.au.description: International news and current affairs television from Paris, offering a French perspective on world events, in English.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: PBS Newshour
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Reviews and analysis of the day's news, presented by Amna Nawaz and Geoff Bennett for the Public Broadcasting Service (PBS) in the United States.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Scottish Islands With Ben Fogle - Isles Of Wind - Orkney
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ben Fogle heads for the Orkney Isles to investigate Norse Christian heritage and how they're a place of modern pilgrimage offering a place of deep time and space to reconnect.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Going Places With Ernie Dingo - Kununurra, Derwent River, Innisfail
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ernie hits the dirt roads and river crossings of Kununurra, Rae catches up with a young Tasmanian marine scientist, and Aaron gets a lesson on the skill of etching with a talented artist.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - Mushrooms
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Adam and his guests, globally acclaimed food writer Emiko Davies and hatted chef Alessandro Pavoni put the 'fun' in 'fungi' with a night of mouth-watering mushroom recipes.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Supervet - Rogan, Brodie And Vinnie
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Boston terrier, Rogan, needs Noel’s help with his debilitating hip dysplasia. Hungarian Vizler Brodie, has elbow dysplasia and has come to see Noel after previous surgery at the hands of another vet went horribly wrong. Vinnie, the tabby cat, is rushed into Fitzpatricks after he is hit by a car.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Jeopardy! - Jeopardy Series 42 Ep 183
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ken Jennings hosts Jeopardy! Where the answers are revealed, and the contestants must guess the appropriate questions.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Letters And Numbers - Letters And Numbers Series 5 Ep 94
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Two contestants pit their linguistic and numerical skills against each other and the clock in this entertaining quiz show. Join host Richard Morecroft along with maths whiz Lily Serna and wordsmith David Astle.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Mastermind - Mastermind Series 5 Ep 83
sbsbrisbane.au.description: In this round, the specialty subjects are The Career of Gina Riley, X-Files: Seasons 3-4, Early Films of Guy Ritchie, and Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News - Sbs World News 2026 Ep 329 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Michael Palin In Venezuela - Episode 1
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Michael lands in deadly Caracas amid Maduro's controversial re-election. He braves dangerous Petare slum, dines at opulent Humboldt Hotel, then explores Amazon rainforest. Meeting indigenous Pemon people, he discovers illegal mining before helicopter landing at Angel Falls.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Roland Garros: Between The Lines - Episode 1
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Opening week at Roland-Garros: while everything has to be ready, nothing is. From the organisation to the courts, the French must prove they belong at the highest level. Behind the scenes, Amelie Mauresmo faces a crisis that could disrupt the three weeks of the tournament: the roof malfunction.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Lowdown - Pilot
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Follows the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon (Ethan Hawke), a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian", whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble. When the publication of Lee's latest expose - a deep dive into the powerful Washberg family - is immediately followed by the suspicious suicide of Dale Washberg, Lee knows he's stumbled onto something big.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News Late - Sbs World News Late 2026 Ep 223 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Corsican Line - Episode 2
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Following a mayor's murder, tensions rise as rival interests compete for control of Corsica's lucrative waste management industry. Reda reconnects with former associates while trying to navigate a dangerous criminal landscape. Meanwhile, Judge Ines pursues her investigation, uncovering links between powerful families, organised crime networks and a business empire with far-reaching influence.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Pagan Peak - Pagan Peak Series 1 Ep 1
sbsbrisbane.au.description: A frozen body is found on the boundary stone right on the Austro-German border, as if propped up for some pagan ritual. Shortly after the disparate investigation duo, police inspector Gedeon Winter from Austria and commissioner Ellie Stocker from Germany, have joined up on the case, the killer sends audio messages to the press.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Pagan Peak - Pagan Peak Series 1 Ep 2
sbsbrisbane.au.description: A German entrepreneur has been killed in Austria. His secret lover was found comatose on a ski piste late at night, drenched in blood. Evidence links this case to the first murder. Ellie, the optimistic and confident investigator from Bavarian Berchtesgaden and her Austrian counterpart Gedeon, the nihilistic cynic from Salzburg, realise they are dealing with a highly intelligent and cold-blooded killer.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Pagan Peak - Pagan Peak Series 1 Ep 3
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Tipped off by the killer’s horrific photo fit, the investigators unearth the Krampus legend - a symbolic creature infamous for punishing the naughty and unworthy. This leads them to Sebastian Brunner, head of a rural sect, whose books on the end of civilisation seem to have inspired the killer.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Pagan Peak - Pagan Peak Series 1 Ep 4
sbsbrisbane.au.description: In a joint effort with cultist Brunner, Ellie and Gedeon try to set a trap for the killer. For this plan to work, they have to overstep legal boundaries. Trying to gain the trust of the killer, they feign a copycat murder, hoping their target would be lured into reaching out to Brunner.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: James May: Our Man In Italy - God's Apology
sbsbrisbane.au.description: James' journey begins with him exploring Sicily, an island where cultures collide under the shadow of Mount Etna. James explores the simple pleasures that have sustained people for generations.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize - Li Hongzhang's Chop Suey
sbsbrisbane.au.description: All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Nhk World English News Morning
sbsbrisbane.au.description: English news from Japan's Broadcasting Corporation, NHK, delivering the latest in business, technology, health, environmental and world news.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Anc Philippines The World Tonight
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Multi-award winning newscast on ABS-CBN and ANC, The World Tonight delivers the top stories of the day, covering political, economic, and social sectors on both local and global fronts.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Legends Of The Fork
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E8 Flavour Pioneers Buddy visits two culinary powerhouses who are bringing the flavours of their native countries to the places they now call home.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Pasta: The Stuff Of Life Sophie cooks orecchiette pasta at home and makes pasta with chickpeas for friends outdoors. She visits a pottery famous for its colourful pasta ceramics.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E10 Sydvestjylland, Denmark Tareq starts the next leg of his journey by visiting Sydvestjylland-a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Moa And More Chef Nornie ventures to the picturesque Moa Island, where she meets with Hans Awang. Together, they explore his lush garden brimming with fresh produce and the bountiful ocean at his doorstep.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E29 Kangaroo Island Around fourteen kilometres off the coast of South Australia lies a beautiful and unspoilt piece of land. Kangaroo Island is five hundred and nine kilometres of stunning and dramatic coastline.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E43 Episode 43 Laura is in the heart of South Australia's most famous wine region, the Barossa Valley, whipping up some family-friendly Cornflake Cookies. Chef Charlie Carrington shares the perfect vegan camp dish.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S4 E13 Salsa Verde Chicken Tortilla Soup Rachael prepares a hearty, protein-packed Salsa Verde Chicken Tortilla Soup that's comforting, delicious, and filling. Meanwhile, John shakes up a refreshing 'White Wedding' cocktail?

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S5 E5 Panetone It's Christmas time, and what better way to celebrate an Italian festive season than with the beloved panettone?

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Nigella Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E13 Safety In Numbers It is Christmas, and Nigella is having a fabulous easy drinks party. On the menu there are meltingly tender turkey meatballs in tomato sauce and a must-have party recipe.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E38 Episode 38 of Season 9 The Prahran Market is buzzing with activity and Wendy from Stir the Pot is joining Laura to create one of her delightful recipes, a clever Potato Tart.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Jamie At Home
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E8 Summer Salad Jamie explains the history of pickling and preserving. If you have grown your own produce, you'll want to save it and keep it for as long as you can.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E67 Episode 67 We love it when Mrs. Schofield joins Justine in the kitchen!

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S6 E13 Food Culture Jung Eun Chae from Chae restaurant and Ukrainian chef Ivegen Klopotenko are in the kitchen with Adam, cooking with fermented ingredients.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E2 Heritage Heritage visits Rumah Putih, experiences Rumah Makan Rendang Tok Yeop and cooks Pucuk Paku Masak Cili Api and Dendeng Daging.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E12 Razzle Dazzle It's party time at Nigella's and this is one party that's full of fast, easy, delicious make in advance recipes and simple, achievable, last minute touches to make the food table and the party itself.

screamboxtv.us.description: A man (Bryce Johnson) and his girlfriend (Alexie Gilmore) camp in the woods to capture firsthand evidence of Bigfoot.

screamboxtv.us.title: Luther the Geek
screamboxtv.us.description: A circus' morbid sideshow attraction leaves an indelible impression on a young boy's mind.

screamboxtv.us.title: Grizzly
screamboxtv.us.description: A forest ranger (Christopher George) tries heavy firepower on a very big Georgia bear loose in a national park.
