screamboxtv.us.title: The Grave
screamboxtv.us.description: The quest for buried treasure leads two escaped convicts (Craig Sheffer, Josh Charles) to old friends, an ex-flame (Gabrielle Anwar) and one's shooting.

screenpix.us.title: The Square Peg
screenpix.us.description: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops.

screenpix.us.title: Albino Alligator
screenpix.us.description: When a robbery in New Orleans ends in disaster, the mercurial burglar Dova escapes with his cohorts to a seedy, nearby bar. Capturing all those inside, the criminals trade barbs with the establishment's feisty bartender Janet Boudreaux. The pub becomes highly volatile, however, when the police encircle it; as it turns out, they were already there surveilling another of the bar's patrons, a suspected illicit arms trafficker named Guy Foucard.

screenpix.us.title: The Limbic Region
screenpix.us.description: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession.

screenpix.us.title: Guns, Girls and Gangsters
screenpix.us.description: A Las Vegas singer (Mamie Van Doren) plans an armored-car robbery with her husband's (Lee Van Cleef) ex-cellmate (Gerald Mohr).

screenpix.us.title: The Last Time I Saw Archie
screenpix.us.description: As World War II winds down, supply pilots at a stateside military base are left with few duties. Cocky Pvt. Archie Hall (Robert Mitchum) shirks even the most menial tasks by slyly leading everyone to believe he's a high-ranking officer working undercover. Alongside his buddy, Pvt. Bill Bowers (Jack Webb), Archie gets entangled with a pair of local women, Peggy (Martha Hyer) and Cindy (France Nuyen) -- one of whom might be passing secrets to the Japanese.

screenpix.us.title: If It's Tuesday, It Still Must Be Belgium
screenpix.us.description: Tourists in Europe join their bus driver (Claude Akins) on a search for his daughter, kidnapped by a circus knife-thrower (Bruce Weitz).

screenpix.us.title: Phantom Killer
screenpix.us.description: A district attorney (Dick Purcell) quits to prove the guilt of an acquitted killer (John Hamilton) who cannot hear or speak.

screenpix.us.title: Article 99
screenpix.us.description: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. Morgan (Kiefer Sutherland), Handleman (Forest Whitaker) and Van Dorn (Lea Thompson), he fights to deliver adequate care to needy veterans in the face of funding cuts and a corrupt administration. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous Article 99, a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

screenpix.us.title: In the Time of the Butterflies
screenpix.us.description: A rebel leader educates a Dominican Republic woman (Salma Hayek) about the abuses of a corrupt dictator (Edward James Olmos).

screenpix.us.title: Park Row
screenpix.us.description: Reporter Phineas Mitchell (Gene Evans) works at a successful newspaper, the Star, but does not respect the publication. After sharing his thoughts about a moral and just newspaper at a local pub, he inspires his colleagues to join him in starting a new paper, the Globe, which is an instant hit. However, the publisher of the Star, Charity Hackett (Mary Welch), will not give up her readership easily and orders sabotage on the Globe -- even as Phineas begins to fall for her.

screenpix.us.description: Two Marines (Fred Clark) fool a German general (Buster Keaton) with documents and disguises in World War II Italy. (movie) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: The Woman in the Window
screenpixaction.us.description: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Man in the Net
screenpixaction.us.description: Big city advertising artist John Hamilton (Alan Ladd) abandons his career and relocates to a sleepy Connecticut community to paint for himself instead of for a paycheck. But his erratic spouse, Linda (Carolyn Jones), quickly grows bored with her quiet new life and begins to lash out at him. After turning to the bottle, Linda begins to openly insult her husband and even accuses him of beating her. So later, when she goes missing, the locals suspect John of murder and an angry mob comes after him.

screenpixaction.us.title: Lady of Vengeance
screenpixaction.us.description: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

screenpixaction.us.title: Four Boys and a Gun
screenpixaction.us.description: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Big Knife
screenpixaction.us.description: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

screenpixaction.us.title: Behind the Mask
screenpixaction.us.description: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Ape
screenpixaction.us.description: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Neanderthal Man
screenpixaction.us.description: A scientist (Robert Shayne) turns his maid into an ape-woman, his cat into a tiger and himself into an ape-man.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Screaming Skull
screenpixaction.us.description: A man (John Hudson) tries to drive his second wife (Peggy Webber) mad at his dead first wife's Southern mansion.

screenpixaction.us.title: Portrait in Terror
screenpixaction.us.description: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

screenpixaction.us.title: Incident in an Alley
screenpixaction.us.description: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy.

screenpixaction.us.title: Warriors of Virtue
screenpixaction.us.description: Lame in one leg, Ryan Jeffers has few friends in his high school and spends most of his time with Chinese restaurant chef Ming, who gives him the Book of Tao. When he is goaded by the football team into a dangerous ceremony, Ryan falls into a whirlpool and emerges in the magical land of Tao. His leg fully healed, he is led to Master Chung, whose heroic warriors battle against greedy Lord Komodo. Ryan joins their fight. (movie) - 1997

screenpixvoices.us.title: Getting Even
screenpixvoices.us.description: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mercenary Fighters
screenpixvoices.us.description: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Windprints
screenpixvoices.us.description: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

screenpixvoices.us.title: For Us, the Living
screenpixvoices.us.description: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mandela
screenpixvoices.us.description: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Blood Red
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the 1890s California, Sicilian winemakers battle with a railroad tycoon over control of the land. William Berrigan will stop at nothing to get what he wants -- a train track running through the valley. Standing in his way is the Collogero family: father Sebastian, son Marco, and daughter Maria. But Berrigan makes a misjudgment when he orders the death of Sebastian, which launches a blood war in the vine-strangled hills.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Rebel in Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Valdez Is Coming
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Halliday Brand
screenpixwesterns.us.description: As his father, Big Dan (Ward Bond), lies dying, estranged son Daniel Halliday (Joseph Cotten) returns to the family cattle ranch and recalls why he left home. Years before, Big Dan discovered that his daughter, Martha (Betsy Blair), was in love with Native American ranch hand Jivaro (Christopher Dark) and had the young man arrested on false charges. Outraged, Daniel left home and teamed with Jivaro's beautiful sister (Viveca Lindfors) and vengeful father (Jay C. Flippen) for retribution.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: More Dead Than Alive
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An outlaw responsible for many deaths, Cain is released from prison after years behind bars. Despite his earlier wicked ways, Cain has made a real effort to reform and just wants to be left in peace. Unfortunately, his reputation limits his employment options, and he's left with no choice except becoming a performer in a Wild West show. Working for promoter Dan Ruffalo, Cain attempts to lead a relatively quiet life, but other gunslingers are still out to get him.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Fever
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After growing up living a life of crime, outlaw Sam Weller (John Lupton) decides to go straight, but neither Sam's father, Trench (Aaron Saxon), nor his thieving cohort, Charlie Whitman (Norman Frederic), take the news well. After Sam invests in a way station with his friend, Luke Ram (Mark Stevens), Trench and Whitman convince a band of Sioux warriors to attack the station. Although Simon eventually forges a peace agreement with the Sioux, a final battle with Trench looms on the horizon.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Law Rides Again
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) use a convict (Jack LaRue) to trap a crooked Indian agent.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Death of Bat Masterson
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Bat arrives at a mining town in Bonanza, Colo., to collect $20,000 in earnings from a cattle drive, he discovers the town believes him dead and gave his money to a woman claiming to be his widow.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Secret Is Death
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The territorial administrator seeks Bat's help in stemming a crime wave in Cheyenne.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Memory
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Liz Dothan persuades Sam Wade to place her jewelry overnight in the Wells Fargo safe, and remembers the combination as she watches him open it; Hollister's sharp mind and keen observations help him solve the subsequent $20,000 theft.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Revenge
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Jonas Bell is killed in a scuffle with Hollister after a bank clerk is murdered; siblings Noah and Lady Bell conspire to avenge their father targeting Hollister.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Alamo: Thirteen Days to Glory
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In 1836, Jim Bowie, Davy Crockett and the Texas rebels make a heroic last stand at the Alamo against the Mexican army of several thousand men led by General Santa Anna.

screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat finds himself involved in the Lincoln assassination conspiracy 15 years after the crime. (Western) - 1959-06-17

screenpixwesterns.us.description: Murderer Sam Edwards has been sentenced to hang, but his brother, John, kidnaps Harris and takes him hostage to save Sam from the gallows. (Western) - 1960-04-08

screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister risks his life to rescue the governor, who has been kidnapped by a gang. (Western) - 1960-04-16

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Shaquille O'Neal
scrippsnews.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Dual Threat
scrippsnews.us.description: Steve Young redefined the quarterback position, setting records as both passer and rusher during his Hall of Fame career; behind the scenes, he battled crippling anxiety that was tougher than any opponent; when football was over, he built a $10 billion business from scratch; Suzy Kolber reconnects with her former broadcast partner to find out what it takes to be a dual threat — on the field and in life.

secnetwork.us.description: The flagship news and information program of the SEC Network -- ESPN's 24/7 multiplatform sports network devoted to the Southeastern Conference -- is "SEC Now," broadcast weekdays from the network's studios in Charlotte, N.C. Hosted by Dari Nowkhah, Peter Burns or Alyssa Lang, the show includes a mix of sports coverage, in-depth features, insider access, and exclusive interviews with the movers and shakers of the conference's 14 teams.

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show

Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

shadesofblack.us.title: Mad Money
shadesofblack.us.description: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

shadesofblack.us.title: Medusa Deluxe
shadesofblack.us.description: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

shadesofblack.us.title: Never Back Down
shadesofblack.us.description: Jake (Sean Faris) moves to Orlando, Fla., with his mother (Leslie Hope) and brother (Wyatt Smith). He feels like an outsider in his new school and frequently lets his temper flare out of control. But Jake wants to fit in, and he decides to go to a party with his classmate Baja (Amber Heard). There, Jake is pushed into a fight and humiliated. Another classmate (Evan Peters) sees what happened, and encourages Jake to visit martial arts trainer Jean Roqua (Djimon Hounsou).

shadesofblack.us.title: Fast and Fierce: Death Race
shadesofblack.us.description: Jack is on his way to grabbing the cash prize for an illegal car race in Mexico to California, when a desperate woman, fleeing from her gangster boyfriend who runs the tournament, jumps into his car pleading for help.

shadesofblack.us.title: Miss Dial
shadesofblack.us.description: A consumer affairs rep in a rocky relationship spends her day calling random people, looking for new connections. She unexpectedly meets someone on the phone that might just change everything, including her heart.

shadesofblack.us.title: Eve of Destruction
shadesofblack.us.description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Last Letter
shadesofblack.us.description: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

shadesofblack.us.title: Original Gangstas
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

shadesofblack.us.title: School Dance
shadesofblack.us.description: A teen (Bobb'e J. Thompson) hopes to impress a girl he likes by winning a spot on his school's hottest dance crew.

shoutmovies.us.description: A playwright/actor (Wallace Shawn) and a playwright/director (Andre Gregory) have a deep discussion in a restaurant.

shoutmovies.us.description: A Maori girl (Keisha Castle-Hughes) defies her grandfather (Rawiri Paratene) and 1,000 years of tradition to prove she can lead their tribe.

showtime.us.title: The Equalizer 2

showtime.us.title: Sleepless
showtime.us.description: An undercover Las Vegas police officer (Jamie Foxx) must race against time to save his kidnapped son (Octavius J. Johnson) from a crew of murderous gangsters.

showtime.us.title: Killer Joe
showtime.us.description: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple).

showtime.us.title: No Country for Old Men
showtime.us.description: An aging lawman (Tommy Lee Jones) reflects on his past and laments a changing world while trying to find and protect a hunter who took the cash from a drug deal gone bad.

showtime.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
showtime.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

showtime.us.title: Not Without Hope
showtime.us.description: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as the Coast Guard launches a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

showtime.us.title: Molly's Game
showtime.us.description: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

showtime.us.title: Ballistic
showtime.us.description: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

showtime.us.title: Almost Famous
showtime.us.description: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour. (Movies, Comedy Drama) - 2000

showtime.us.title: Noah
showtime.us.description: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood. (Movies, History) - 2014

showtime.us.title: Days of Thunder
showtime.us.description: An upstart stock-car driver goes to the edge for his manager, his brain-surgeon girlfriend and himself. (Movies, Action) - 1990

showtime2west.us.title: Not Without Hope
showtime2west.us.description: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as the Coast Guard launches a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

showtime2west.us.title: The Back-up Plan
showtime2west.us.description: A single woman (Jennifer Lopez) meets the man (Alex O'Loughlin) of her dreams on the same day she becomes pregnant through artificial insemination.

showtime2west.us.title: No Strings Attached
showtime2west.us.description: After sex enters the equation, two lifelong friends (Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher) make a pact to keep their relationship purely physical.

showtime2west.us.title: It Gets Worse
showtime2west.us.description: S01 E05 Stop All The Cocks Ethan, Abi and Sam attend a funeral for an old friend from university; the funeral brings their love and loneliness to the surface; Abi reflects on her relationship with Tom; Ethan pursues Aaron; and Sam wrestles with her guilt.

showtime2west.us.title: It Gets Worse
showtime2west.us.description: S01 E06 People Team Ethan, Abi and Sam attempt to reconcile, but the new chapter only reveals that their messy lives are far from resolved; surely it gets better than this, right? But who needs better, when they have each other?

showtime2west.us.title: Hostage
showtime2west.us.description: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint.

showtime2west.us.title: Enemy at the Gates
showtime2west.us.description: A Nazi sniper (Ed Harris) travels to Stalingrad to find and kill a Russian sharpshooter (Jude Law), the hero of the propaganda campaign of a political officer (Joseph Fiennes).

showtime2west.us.title: Hard Rain
showtime2west.us.description: A thief (Morgan Freeman), a sheriff (Randy Quaid) and the nephew (Christian Slater) of an armored-truck driver seek money bags in a flooding Indiana town.

showtime2west.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
showtime2west.us.description: A troubled Gulf War veteran (Denzel Washington) becomes suspicious after a powerful senator's (Meryl Streep) son (Liev Schreiber) becomes a candidate for vice president.

showtime2west.us.title: Red Eye
showtime2west.us.description: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official.

showtime2west.us.title: Rock of Ages
showtime2west.us.description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtime2west.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtime2west.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Grizzly Night
showtimeextreme.us.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks.

showtimeextreme.us.title: True Grit
showtimeextreme.us.description: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

showtimeextreme.us.title: American Assassin
showtimeextreme.us.description: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Super
showtimeextreme.us.description: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Galaxy Quest
showtimeextreme.us.description: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Rock of Ages
showtimeextreme.us.description: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Paranormal Activity
showtimeextreme.us.description: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Perfect Gamble
showtimeextreme.us.description: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
showtimeextreme.us.description: When the man she loves, Holger Olsen, goes off to fight in the Civil War, Vivienne Le Coudy must fend for herself in a place controlled by a corrupt mayor and his unscrupulous business partner. When Olsen returns from the war, he and Vivienne must confront and make peace with the person each has become.

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Cut
showtimeextreme.us.description: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Due Justice
showtimeextreme.us.description: Consumed by grief and driven by revenge, a former Marine embarks on a relentless mission to hunt down those responsible for the brutal murders of his beloved wife and daughter. (movie) - 2023

showtimeextreme.us.title: Stop-Loss
showtimeextreme.us.description: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma. (movie) - 2008

showtimefamily.us.title: Stardust
showtimefamily.us.description: To win the heart of his beloved, a young man (Charlie Cox) ventures into the realm of fairies to retrieve a fallen star (Claire Danes).

showtimefamily.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
showtimefamily.us.description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

showtimefamily.us.title: Sahara
showtimefamily.us.description: A treasure hunter (Matthew McConaughey) and his sidekick (Steve Zahn) join forces with a doctor (Penélope Cruz) to search for a Confederate ship in Africa.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Dark Tower
showtimefamily.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, must prevent the Man in Black (Matthew McConaughey) from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together.

showtimefamily.us.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
showtimefamily.us.description: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
showtimefamily.us.description: Combining unheard audio recordings, dramatic reconstructions and personal archives, filmmakers Peter Middleton and James Spinney trace Charlie Chaplin's meteoric rise from the slums of Victorian London to the heights of Hollywood superstardom.

showtimefamily.us.title: Snoopy, Come Home
showtimefamily.us.description: The "Peanuts" gang becomes upset when the beloved beagle decides to leave home in search of his roots.

showtimefamily.us.title: Serendipity
showtimefamily.us.description: A man (John Cusack) and a woman (Kate Beckinsale) try to find each other after spending one night together 10 years earlier.

showtimefamily.us.title: Three Wishes
showtimefamily.us.description: A frustrated family man recalls an encounter he (Joseph Mazzello), his widowed mom (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio) and his family had with a mysterious vagrant (Patrick Swayze) in 1955 suburbia.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Terminal
showtimefamily.us.description: Unauthorized to enter the United States, an Eastern European (Tom Hanks) befriends a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones) while living in a New York airport.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Wedding Singer
showtimefamily.us.description: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

showtimefamily.us.title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
showtimefamily.us.description: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve.

showtimefamily.us.title: Hotel for Dogs
showtimefamily.us.description: After moving into a foster home that forbids pets, siblings (Emma Roberts, Jake T. Austin) transform an abandoned hotel into a home for their pooch and a slew of stray dogs.

showtimefamily.us.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
showtimefamily.us.description: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.

showtimenext.us.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
showtimenext.us.description: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician.

showtimenext.us.title: Queen of the Desert
showtimenext.us.description: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire.

showtimenext.us.title: Lilies Not for Me
showtimenext.us.description: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

showtimenext.us.title: Don Jon
showtimenext.us.description: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.

showtimenext.us.title: All the World Is Sleeping
showtimenext.us.description: A young mother in New Mexico sinks deeper into addiction while struggling to care for her daughter.

showtimenext.us.title: The Last Airbender
showtimenext.us.description: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world.

showtimenext.us.title: Moonage Daydream
showtimenext.us.description: Featuring never-before-seen footage and performances, filmmaker Brett Morgen explores David Bowie's creative, spiritual and musical journey.

showtimenext.us.title: Marshmallow
showtimenext.us.description: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp.

showtimenext.us.title: Walking Out
showtimenext.us.description: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

showtimenext.us.title: Bleed for This
showtimenext.us.description: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. (movie) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: Daniela Forever
showtimenext.us.description: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams. (movie) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: Jersey Girl
showtimenext.us.description: Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life. (movie) - 2004

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Death of Stalin
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government?

showtimeshowcase.us.title: A Night at the Roxbury
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Office Christmas Party
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass: The Movie
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass: Number Two
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Along Came a Spider
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Brave the Dark
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Crawlspace
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
showtimeshowcase.us.description: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) is doing hard time in jail when his former boss, Col. Trautman (Richard Crenna), offers him a deal. If Rambo travels to Vietnam to try to find the American prisoners of war, his criminal record will be expunged. Rambo takes the reconnaissance assignment and agrees not to get involved in any of the action. However, when his Vietnamese lover, Co Bao (Julia Nickson), is killed by American forces, Rambo forgets his promise and takes matters into his own hands.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Hunt for Red October
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Foreigner
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. (movie) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Behind Enemy Lines
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A Navy pilot (Owen Wilson) is shot down over enemy territory, and struggles to survive the relentless pursuit of a ruthless secret police enforcer, a deadly tracker, and countless hostile troops. With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission. (movie) - 2001

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Dunkirk
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. (movie) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: Dreamgirls
showtimewomen.us.description: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame.

showtimewomen.us.title: Selena
showtimewomen.us.description: In this biographical drama, Selena Quintanilla (Jennifer Lopez) is born into a musical Mexican-American family in Texas. Her father, Abraham (Edward James Olmos), realizes that his young daughter is talented and begins performing with her at small venues. She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez (Jon Seda), who draws the ire of her father. Seeking mainstream stardom, Selena begins recording an English-language album which, tragically, she would never complete.

showtimewomen.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
showtimewomen.us.description: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat.

showtimewomen.us.title: Sweetness
showtimewomen.us.description: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love.

showtimewomen.us.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
showtimewomen.us.description: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

showtimewomen.us.title: She's All That
showtimewomen.us.description: High school hotshot Zach Siler (Freddie Prinze Jr.) is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen.

showtimewomen.us.title: Christmas Takes Flight
showtimewomen.us.description: A number-crunching CEO buys a family-owned airline and cancels the airline's annual holiday charitable benefit. A pilot rallies the community to help save the event and unexpectedly finds herself falling for the magnate in the process.

showtimewomen.us.title: Up in the Air
showtimewomen.us.description: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light.

showtimewomen.us.title: Gravity
showtimewomen.us.description: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

showtimewomen.us.title: The Aviator
showtimewomen.us.description: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall.

showtimewomen.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
showtimewomen.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (movie) - 1999

showtimewomen.us.title: Restoration
showtimewomen.us.description: In order to keep one of his mistresses, Celia (Polly Walker), at arm's length, King Charles II (Sam Neill) asks the royal physician, Robert Merivel (Robert Downey Jr.), to marry her under the proviso that they never become intimate. Merivel agrees, only to discover he can't resist Celia, and soon finds himself out of the king's favor. Destitute, he devotes himself to helping Londoners suffering from the plague, and in the process falls in love with an equally poor woman, Katharine (Meg Ryan). (movie) - 1995

shoxbetwest.us.title: Seaside
shoxbetwest.us.description: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house.

shoxbetwest.us.description: "Video Music Box," launched in 1983 and hosted in New York City by DJ Ralph McDaniels, showcases hip-hop videos and introduces viewers to future stars like Nas, Jay-Z, LL Cool J, Nicki Minaj and Fat Joe long before they become icons of the genre.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
shoxbetwest.us.description: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement. (movie) - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: Heist 88
shoxbetwest.us.description: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system. (movie) - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Silent Planet
shoxbetwest.us.description: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. (movie) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
shoxbetwest.us.description: Michael and Madison Roland planned to spend the rest of their lives together, but Michael's controlling ways turn their perfect marriage into an abusive roller-coaster ride that no woman could survive. With the help of her best friend, Madison decides to get away. After adopting a new identity, she meets Alex Stone and learns to love again. All seems well until Michael discovers Madison's whereabouts and re-creates her nightmare. (movie) - 2017

skyaction.uk.title: Hummingbird
skyaction.uk.description: Reeling from a traumatic tour of duty in Afghanistan, Joey, a former special forces soldier, returns to London to face another kind of war: life on the streets as a damaged, homeless veteran. In an attempt to rehabilitate himself, Joey assumes another man's identity and seeks the aid of Sister Cristina, a young nun who works at an inner-city parish.

skyaction.uk.title: The Legend of Tarzan
skyaction.uk.description: It's been nearly a decade since Tarzan, also known as John Clayton III, left Africa to live in Victorian England with his wife Jane. Danger lurks on the horizon as Leon Rom, a treacherous envoy for King Leopold, devises a scheme that lures the couple to the Congo. Rom plans to capture Tarzan and deliver him to an old enemy in exchange for diamonds. When Jane becomes a pawn in his devious plot, Tarzan must return to the jungle to save the woman he loves.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Trains - Glacier Express

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Trains - Bernina Express

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Universal Soldier: Day of Reckoning
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Archenemies Luc Devereaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) and Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren) contend with a terrifying army of reanimated super soldiers.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Outpost
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Hoping to find lost Nazi gold, mercenaries enter a long-abandoned bunker and encounter a horde of murderous undead creatures.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: The Foreigner
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Assassins pursue a secret agent (Steven Seagal) transporting a mysterious package from France to America.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Flight of Fury
sonymoviechannel.us.description: After corrupt pilot Ratcher (Steve Toussaint) steals an experimental stealth force bomber from the Air Force, his former mentor, John Sands (Steven Seagal), is bailed out of jail and offered a clean record if he retrieves the plane. Partnered with Capt. Richard Jannick (Mark Bazeley), John travels to Afghanistan -- where he learns the craft has landed in the hands of vengeful Islamic terrorist Peter Stone (Vincenzo Nicoli), who plans to use it against the United States in a deadly attack.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Linewatch
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Border agent Michael Dixon's (Cuba Gooding Jr.) past as a gang member comes back to haunt him years later.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Places in the Heart
sonymoviechannel.us.description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower (Tom Selleck) faces monumental decisions in the 90 days leading to the Allied invasion of Normandy in 1944.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Sahara
sonymoviechannel.us.description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Lt. Rip Crandall (Jack Lemmon) is entrusted with one of the most important missions of his World War II career: to shuttle an Australian spy (Chips Rafferty) into enemy territory. Unfortunately, he'll be doing it with one of the Navy's least seaworthy vessels, the USS Echo. But even in a clunker of a ship, Crandall and his madcap crew -- including his enthusiastic young ensign (Ricky Nelson) -- do their best to make their ill-equipped mission a success.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Major Dundee
sonymoviechannel.us.description: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Legend of the Golden Gun
sonymoviechannel.us.description: An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun. (movie) - 1979

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Cowboy Up
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Hank (Kiefer Sutherland) and Ely Braxton (Marcus Thomas) are brothers and rivals. They're each haunted by the specter of their dad, Reid (Pete Postlethwaite), a famous bull rider turned absent father. Hank is a rodeo clown who breeds bulls; Ely is a brash young rider who won't let anything -- not even life-threatening injuries -- keep him out of the ring. When rodeo sweetheart Celia (Daryl Hannah) gets between them, sibling rivalry grows volatile and loyalties are tested. (movie) - 2000

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cookin' With Cutty
spectrumoc16.us.description: Cutty meets a group of kids who give back to their community in very special ways. This inspires everyone to donate to a local charity who provides free meals to those in need. After yoga, kids prepare homemade salad dressing from local ingredients.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Outside Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Explore bright spots in conservation across our island chain - from the mountain tops to the surrounding sea. Learn from scientists, educators and community leaders working side-by-side to protect our reefs, food and native ecosystems.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaiian Xtreme Sports TV
spectrumoc16.us.description: The 2026 Hawaii Waterman Hall of Fame inductees: an internationally renowned paddling coach, a Molokaʻi Hoe champion who helped advance surf-ski design through Rose Ski, an Olympic swimming coach and a pioneering surfer and ocean safety advocate.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ocean Paddler TV
spectrumoc16.us.description: Check out the Pailolo Challenge six-man race in record-breaking conditions.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
spectrumoc16.us.description: When you talk about poke you can't help but mention Sam Choy in the conversation. The beloved chef, restaurateur, television personality and James Beard Award-winner shares his recipe for Mediterranean Ahi Poke.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaii Skin Diver
spectrumoc16.us.description: Journey to Christmas Island for a Red Sea Ocean Adventure trip-of-a-lifetime to target the Giant Trevally.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Sports People Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Abraham Tanaka, a golfer in his 90s, shoots his age; Kailua Canoe Club paddlers compete in the Molokai Hoe race to honor the memory of a teammate who passed away just before the event.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Board Stories
spectrumoc16.us.description: From Pipeline to Jaws, Brazil to El Salvador, Mike Latronic chases the world's best surf; slo-mo barrels, top-level free surfing, and monster big waves, shot with Brent Bielmann.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ultimate Japan
spectrumoc16.us.description: The Suzuis will visit one of Okinawa's popular marketplaces, Heiwa Dori. They will be showing Okinawan souvenirs, have delicious seafood prepared right in front of their eyes, and talk with Grant Murata, one of Hawaii's top Okinawan musicians.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Pet Hui
spectrumoc16.us.description: Visit the Mega Monster Mash and meet an unusual pet, the Ukrainian Levkoy; it is a medium-sized cat breed known for its hairless or peach-fuzz body, wrinkled skin, folded ears and angular, dog-like profile.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ninth Island Connection
spectrumoc16.us.description: Talk with Plaza CEO Jonathan Jossel, former mayor and attorney-to-the-mob Oscar Goodman, and Chef Ben Jenkins of Oscar's Steakhouse.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Da Braddahs & Friends

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Joy of Crafting

spectrumoc16.us.title: Here in Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: After the Kona Low floods, attention turns to protecting communities from future flooding. In the forest with Ko?olau Mountains Watershed Partnership, see how crews control invasive trees, protect native forests and restore stream corridors.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
spectrumoc16.us.description: Dr. Jamee Miller, co-founder of Ekolu Mea Nui, leads a Native Hawaiian ohana-led nonprofit transforming Hawaii's justice system through cultural practices, including healing through farming at Ho'iwai; a proud mom and tutu, she shares family recipes.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Showcase Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Capture Hawaii's shores with the Freshwater Pearl Starfish CZ Anklet—an adjustable double-chain design with sparkling CZs, a pavé starfish, and a pearl accent. Gold or silver-plated over copper; perfect for everyday or beach wear.

starz.us.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
starz.us.description: After losing his mother to murder as a boy, Marcus (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) has little support in his life. He starts working for drug dealer Levar (Bill Duke) and his assistant (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje). Although Marcus makes good money selling, his dream is to become a rapper. When he reunites with an old love (Joy Bryant) and is later shot numerous times during a robbery, Marcus decides it's time to change his life. However, his old associates won't let him go so easily.

starz.us.title: Oscar Shaw
starz.us.description: Haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend, a retired detective embarks on a perilous quest for vengeance as he fights to restore justice to the streets he once protected.

starz.us.title: The Perfect Holiday
starz.us.description: Nancy (Gabrielle Union), a divorced mother of three, feels especially lonely during the holidays. Sensing her sadness, Nancy's youngest daughter, Emily (Khail Bryant), has a plan to make her mom happy again. She asks Benjamin (Morris Chestnut), a department-store Santa Claus, to pay Nancy a compliment. And Benjamin, who is also a struggling songwriter, knows exactly the right words to say.

starz.us.title: Nas: Time Is Illmatic
starz.us.description: Rapper Nas recalls his youth in his city's housing projects, his parents' influence and the recording of his 1994 debut album, "Illmatic."

starz.us.title: The Longest Yard
starz.us.description: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

starz.us.title: Pixels
starz.us.description: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

starz.us.title: The Perfect Holiday

She asks Benjamin (Morris Chestnut), a department-store Santa Claus, to pay Nancy a compliment. And Benjamin, who is also a struggling songwriter, knows exactly the right words to say.

starz.us.title: First Sunday
starz.us.description: Petty thieves Durell and LeeJohn face a big problem: The two must come up with $17,000 in one week, or Durell will no longer be able to see his son. The goofy scoundrels embark on a haphazard plan to rob the neighborhood church, but they find the mission trickier than expected. When they arrive, they discover that somebody equally disreputable has already had his hand in the coffers. Now, they must trace the money to a group of parishioners.

starz.us.title: Enough
starz.us.description: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman.

starz.us.title: The Furious
starz.us.description: After Wang Wei's daughter is kidnapped by a criminal network, his only ally is Navin, a journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo finds themselves in an explosive martial-arts showdown against a relentless gang of thugs. (movie) - 2025

starz.us.title: Paul
starz.us.description: For the past 60 years, a wisecracking alien named Paul (Seth Rogen) has resided at a top-secret military base in America's UFO heartland. When Paul decides he has had enough of Earth, he escapes from the compound and hops on the first handy vehicle -- a rented RV manned by two British sci-fi nerds named Graeme (Simon Pegg) and Clive (Nick Frost). With federal agents and the father of an accidental kidnap victim on their tail, the two hatch a crazy plan to help Paul return to his spaceship. (movie) - 2011

starz.us.title: Power Ballad
starz.us.description: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick's songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves, even if it means risking everything he cares about. (movie) - 2026

starzcinema.us.title: The Dangerous Lives of Altar Boys
starzcinema.us.description: Francis Doyle (Emile Hirsch) and Tim Sullivan (Kieran Culkin), and their closest friends, are fighting the stultifying repression of their parish school. Foremost among the forces of evil is the stern and disapproving nun, Sister Assumpta (Jodie Foster), who rules their lives. She seizes their artwork one day, setting the boys on an obsessed trail of revenge that ultimately changes their lives.

starzcinema.us.title: Speak No Evil
starzcinema.us.description: A dream holiday turns into a living nightmare when an American couple and their daughter spend the weekend at a British family's idyllic country estate.

starzcinema.us.title: The Devil You Know
starzcinema.us.description: Ex-con Marcus Cowans is trying to turn over a new leaf with the support of his loving family. After learning that one of his brothers may have been involved in a horrific crime, Marcus grapples with the limits of loyalty. He and his family, increasingly weary of the justice system's failings, soon end up in the crosshairs of a seasoned but jaded detective.

starzcinema.us.title: Isolation

starzcinema.us.title: With/in

starzcinema.us.title: Dìdi
starzcinema.us.description: In 2008, during the last month of summer before high school begins, an impressionable 13-year-old Taiwanese American boy learns what his family can't teach him: how to skate, how to flirt, and how to love his mom.

starzcinema.us.title: Empire Waist
starzcinema.us.description: Lenore Miller is a plus size, insecure teen whose talent for fashion is discovered by her confident, plus-sized classmate, forcing her into the spotlight and into the path of both bullies and new friends. But her image-conscious mother's fears and Lenore's own deep self-loathing prevent her from wearing her own designs. Will Lenore ever feel the self-love she inspires in others?

starzcinema.us.title: The Promise
starzcinema.us.description: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety.

starzcinema.us.title: Fierce People
starzcinema.us.description: Finn (Anton Yelchin) is a teenager trying to escape his drug-addicted mother (Diane Lane) by going to study tribal people. His hopes are dashed when he gets caught scoring drugs for her, and she decides to start their lives over by moving them in with her massage client, billionaire Ogden (Donald Sutherland). At first, Finn indulges in the luxury around him and falls for Ogden's granddaughter (Kristen Stewart), but he soon finds that the rich can be more savage than any group in the wild.

starzcinema.us.title: Blame
starzcinema.us.description: A substitute drama teacher at a suburban high school develops a taboo relationship with an unstable student, sparking a trail of jealous sabotage from the student's peers. (movie) - 2017

starzcinema.us.title: Hostiles
starzcinema.us.description: In 1892, legendary Army Capt. Joseph Blocker reluctantly agrees to escort a dying Cheyenne war chief and his family back to their tribal land. Embarking on a harrowing and perilous journey from Fort Berringer, N.M., to the grasslands of Montana, they soon encounter a young widow whose family was killed on the plains. The travelers must now band together to survive a punishing landscape that's crawling with hostile Comanches and vicious outlaws. (movie) - 2017

starzcomedy.us.title: Lay the Favorite

starzcomedy.us.title: This Christmas

However, family ties show signs of strain when various secrets come to light, especially concerning Marine Claude's (Columbus Short) true military status, Quentin's (Idris Elba) debts and teenage Baby's (Chris Brown) secret plans to become a singer.

starzcomedy.us.title: Tales From the Crypt Presents Demon Knight
starzcomedy.us.description: Ex-soldier Frank Brayker (William Sadler) is the guardian of an ancient key that can unlock tremendous evil; the sinister but charming Collector (Billy Zane) is a demon who wants the key so he can initiate the apocalypse. On the run from wicked mercenaries for almost 90 years, Brayker finally stops in at a boarding house in New Mexico where -- with the help of its quirky residents -- he plans to face off against the Collector and his band of ghouls, preventing them from ever seizing the key.

starzcomedy.us.title: Dinocroc vs. Supergator

starzcomedy.us.title: Twice Upon a Yesterday
starzcomedy.us.description: Victor Bukowski cheats on girlfriend Sylvia Weld, who rebounds and gets engaged to Dave Summers. Wishing he could undo his error, Victor happens upon two otherworldly trash collectors, who send him back in time. He uses the opportunity to woo Sylvia again, while making sure that an attractive woman catches Dave's eye. But his attraction to a waitress, Louise, could ruin Victor's plan to right things with Sylvia.

starzcomedy.us.title: Hittin' It!

starzcomedy.us.title: Solitary Man

Even Ben's current girlfriend Jordan knows he's far from perfect. But a hastily planned trip to Boston -- he's showing Jordan's teen daughter, Allyson, one of the city's many colleges -- just might rouse Ben from his losing streak.

starzcomedy.us.title: Out on Parole

starzencoreclassic.us.title: The Girl in the Spider's Web
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Fired from the National Security Agency, Frans Balder recruits hacker Lisbeth Salander to steal Firewall, a computer program that can access codes for nuclear weapons worldwide. The download soon draws attention from an NSA agent who traces the activity to Stockholm. Further problems arise when Russian thugs take Lisbeth's laptop and kidnap a math whiz who can make Firewall work. Now, Lisbeth and an unlikely ally must race against time to save the boy and recover the codes to avert disaster.

Rafe eventually determines that Caleb is in the thrall of Lilith (Angie Everhart), a powerful vampire who operates a seedy brothel. When Rafe and Katherine set out to rescue Caleb, they must contend with the lethal Lilith and her evil minions.

starzencoreclassic.us.title: The Row
starzencoreclassic.us.description: An incoming college freshman must endure cruel hazing rituals and somehow evade a demented serial killer who is targeting her sorority sisters.

starzencoreclassic.us.title: I'm Not There
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Several actors portray legendary singer-songwriter Bob Dylan at different stages in his personal life and career. In 1959 a guitar-strumming youth (Marcus Carl Franklin) rides the rails, calling himself "Guthrie." Then a man named Jack (Christian Bale) emerges in New York's Greenwich Village, followed by "Robbie (Heath Ledger)," Jude (Cate Blanchett) and other personalities.

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Dinocroc vs. Supergator

starzencoreclassic.us.description: Boston cop Pally (Kiefer Sutherland) is forced into early retirement, putting a strain on his marriage. But their attempts to secure the champion equine are thwarted by a local mob boss (Daniel Benzali), who steals the horse as repayment for a gambling debt. With their investment on the line, Pally and Ray become entangled in a web of underworld crime and murder.

Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet. (movie) - 2015

A connection forms between the unhappy pair, who soon find themselves falling in love.

starzencorewesterns.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Damsel
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Samuel Alabaster, an affluent pioneer, ventures across the American frontier to marry the love of his life, Penelope. As his group traverses the West, the once-simple journey grows treacherous, blurring the lines between hero, villain and damsel.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: The Burrowers
starzencorewesterns.us.description: A rescue party comes face to face with underground creatures attacking a town.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Panhandle
starzencorewesterns.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Bad Man's River
starzencorewesterns.us.description: An outlaw and two con men attempt to relieve the Mexican government of $1 million. Once the scam is completed, they have to avoid the attentions of, amongst others, the Mexican army and Billy the Kid - all of whom are eager to claim the cash for themselves.

starzencorewesterns.us.title: The Proud Rebel
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Bar 20 Justice

starzencorewesterns.us.description: Hopalong Cassidy fools even his partner by acting like a badman to catch a gang of badmen.

starzinblack.us.title: Pain & Gain

To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.

starzinblack.us.title: Empire Waist
starzinblack.us.description: Lenore Miller is a plus size, insecure teen whose talent for fashion is discovered by her confident, plus-sized classmate, forcing her into the spotlight and into the path of both bullies and new friends. But her image-conscious mother's fears and Lenore's own deep self-loathing prevent her from wearing her own designs. Will Lenore ever feel the self-love she inspires in others?

starzinblack.us.title: Motives
starzinblack.us.description: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox).

starzinblack.us.title: Motives 2: Retribution
starzinblack.us.description: A man (Brian J. White) cuts through lies and deceit to investigate the murder of his imprisoned brother (Shemar Moore).

starzinblack.us.title: Seized
starzinblack.us.description: A former special forces agent's son is kidnapped and must now wipe out three dangerous crime syndicates, if he wants to see his son alive again.

starzinblack.us.title: Bulletproof
starzinblack.us.description: A none-too-bright criminal, Archie Moses (Adam Sandler) works for drug kingpin Frank Colton (James Caan) and remains oblivious to the fact that one of his closest buddies is actually an undercover police officer named Jack Carter (Damon Wayans). After Moses accidentally shoots Carter, the cop must recover and then bring the two-bit thug in to take the stand against Colton. With Carter and Moses on far from good terms, however, the trip does not go well.

starzinblack.us.title: Bulletproof 2
starzinblack.us.description: Special Agent Jack Carter is assigned to take down a powerful South African crime family. Carter assumes the identity of Archie Moses, a criminal with crucial ties to the case but more notably the person who accidentally shot him in the head 25 years earlier. When a meeting between two cartel syndicates goes horribly wrong, the real Moses gets unwittingly put in danger. Carter and Moses must figure out how to stay alive while trying to foil an international money laundering scheme.

starzinblack.us.title: Power Book III: Raising Kanan - School of War

starzinblack.us.title: Power Book III: Raising Kanan - Dark Matter
starzinblack.us.description: Kanan and Tiana's relationship takes a turn; Garcia makes a bold move to get Juke her answers.

starzinblack.us.title: Mo' Money
