Soon, he learns that going straight doesn't pay very well, so he decides to nab a company credit card and show off his newfound wealth to Amber. Unfortunately, a blackmailer catches Johnny and forces him to commit a crime that is far from small.

starzinblack.us.title: Feast of Love
starzinblack.us.description: The love lives of several people of various ages intersect when a young woman named Chloe (Alexa Davalos) comes to town. Immediately, barista Oscar (Toby Hemingway) is enamored with her and thrilled when his boss, Bradley (Greg Kinnear), hires her. Then Bradley's wife, Kathryn (Selma Blair), leaves him for someone else. Afterward Bradley marries realtor Diana (Radha Mitchell), who helps the first couple move in together. Harry (Morgan Freeman) watches it all quietly and muses on love and loss.

starzinblack.us.title: Bulletproof
starzinblack.us.description: A none-too-bright criminal, Archie Moses (Adam Sandler) works for drug kingpin Frank Colton (James Caan) and remains oblivious to the fact that one of his closest buddies is actually an undercover police officer named Jack Carter (Damon Wayans). After Moses accidentally shoots Carter, the cop must recover and then bring the two-bit thug in to take the stand against Colton. With Carter and Moses on far from good terms, however, the trip does not go well. (movie) - 1996

starzinblack.us.title: Bulletproof 2
starzinblack.us.description: Special Agent Jack Carter is assigned to take down a powerful South African crime family. Carter assumes the identity of Archie Moses, a criminal with crucial ties to the case but more notably the person who accidentally shot him in the head 25 years earlier. When a meeting between two cartel syndicates goes horribly wrong, the real Moses gets unwittingly put in danger. Carter and Moses must figure out how to stay alive while trying to foil an international money laundering scheme. (movie) - 2020

starzinblack.us.title: Armed Response
starzinblack.us.description: When a home security business falls on hard times, the owners decide to start robbing local houses in an attempt to add to their income and create a need for their services. The plan seems to work until, in an attempt to one-up the competition, they finish a job with more in their haul than they bargained for. (movie) - 2013

starzinblack.us.title: Phat Beach
starzinblack.us.description: A teen Romeo pulls an aspiring-writer pal into his plan to sell cheap sunglasses to Southern California beachgoers. (movie) - 1996

starzkids&family.us.title: Bandslam
starzkids&family.us.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

starzkids&family.us.title: The Great Gilly Hopkins
starzkids&family.us.description: Young and feisty Gilly Hopkins (Sophie Nélisse) devises a scheme to escape from her new foster home and reunite with her birth mother.

starzkids&family.us.title: Centurion: The Dancing Stallion
starzkids&family.us.description: Ellissia adopts a white stallion to train in the art of Mexican horse dancing. As she starts teaching the handsome but previously abused Centurion, Ellissia falls critically ill, which keeps her from competing in a celebrated equestrian event. Under the watchful eyes of her father, new ranch hand Danny steps in as trainer, hoping to win the competition -- and, perhaps, Ellissia's heart.

starzkids&family.us.title: Space Chimps
starzkids&family.us.description: Ham III (Andy Samberg) is the grandson of the first chimpanzee who first blasted into outer space. He and two other chimp astronauts go on a dangerous mission through a black hole. Landing on an inhabited planet, the space-faring simians must help depose a planetary tyrant, then find a way back to their own world.

starzkids&family.us.title: The Blue Elephant
starzkids&family.us.description: A young, carefree elephant (Thomas Sharkey) becomes separated from his herd and seeks help from new friends.

starzkids&family.us.title: Sea Level
starzkids&family.us.description: When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.

starzkids&family.us.title: Sea Level 2: Magic Arch
starzkids&family.us.description: A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

starzkids&family.us.title: Sea Level 3: Dolphin Boy
starzkids&family.us.description: A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.

starzkids&family.us.title: A Mermaid's Tale
starzkids&family.us.description: Twelve-year-old Ryan is despondent about moving to a dying seacoast village until she forms an unlikely friendship with a quirky teenage mermaid.

starzkids&family.us.title: Bart Got a Room
starzkids&family.us.description: Everyone is searching for love in director Brian Hecker's semi-autobiographical story. Danny Stein, a high school senior at the bottom of the social food chain, needs a prom date. As a cause of anxiety for Danny, Bart Beeber, the nerdiest guy in school, has already found a date -- and booked a hotel room. At the same time, Danny's divorced parents are both looking for relationships again.

starzkids&family.us.title: The Blue Elephant

starzkids&family.us.title: I Can Only Imagine 2
starzkids&family.us.description: After the success of the song "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard has it all until fame starts to cost him what matters most. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life.

starzkids&family.us.title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
starzkids&family.us.description: The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You." (Holiday, Special, Entertainment, Music) - 2022-12-20

starzwest.us.title: Fightland - You Won't See Me Coming
starzwest.us.description: An explosive showdown leads Duke to a surprising truth, rocking him to the core, as an audacious move captures the world's attention.

starzwest.us.title: Beast
starzwest.us.description: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built.

starzwest.us.title: Splash City
starzwest.us.description: While Slim sees basketball as a way out, his brother Juju falls deeper into street crime. Together they must choose between a brighter future and a violent legacy.

starzwest.us.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
starzwest.us.description: After losing his mother to murder as a boy, Marcus (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) has little support in his life. He starts working for drug dealer Levar (Bill Duke) and his assistant (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje). Although Marcus makes good money selling, his dream is to become a rapper. When he reunites with an old love (Joy Bryant) and is later shot numerous times during a robbery, Marcus decides it's time to change his life. However, his old associates won't let him go so easily.

starzwest.us.title: Oscar Shaw
starzwest.us.description: Haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend, a retired detective embarks on a perilous quest for vengeance as he fights to restore justice to the streets he once protected.

starzwest.us.title: The Perfect Holiday
starzwest.us.description: Nancy (Gabrielle Union), a divorced mother of three, feels especially lonely during the holidays. Sensing her sadness, Nancy's youngest daughter, Emily (Khail Bryant), has a plan to make her mom happy again. She asks Benjamin (Morris Chestnut), a department-store Santa Claus, to pay Nancy a compliment. And Benjamin, who is also a struggling songwriter, knows exactly the right words to say.

starzwest.us.title: Nas: Time Is Illmatic
starzwest.us.description: Rapper Nas recalls his youth in his city's housing projects, his parents' influence and the recording of his 1994 debut album, "Illmatic."

starzwest.us.title: The Longest Yard
starzwest.us.description: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

starzwest.us.title: Pixels
starzwest.us.description: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

starzwest.us.title: The Perfect Holiday
starzwest.us.description: Nancy (Gabrielle Union), a divorced mother of three, feels especially lonely during the holidays. starzwest.us.title: First Sunday
starzwest.us.description: Petty thieves Durell and LeeJohn face a big problem: The two must come up with $17,000 in one week, or Durell will no longer be able to see his son. The goofy scoundrels embark on a haphazard plan to rob the neighborhood church, but they find the mission trickier than expected. When they arrive, they discover that somebody equally disreputable has already had his hand in the coffers. Now, they must trace the money to a group of parishioners. (movie) - 2008

starzwest.us.title: Enough
starzwest.us.description: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman. (movie) - 2002

starzwest.us.title: The Furious
starzwest.us.description: After Wang Wei's daughter is kidnapped by a criminal network, his only ally is Navin, a journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo finds themselves in an explosive martial-arts showdown against a relentless gang of thugs. (movie) - 2025

The next day the duo head out of the city towards the beautiful Blue Mountains, but once again, Brad's fear of heights is put to the test when they take a ride on what turns out to be an extreme cable car.

stvnorth.uk.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad

Later, the road trip takes them to a tiny town where they join the local community who have organised a challenge that involves pulling a gigantic truck.

syfy.us.title: Die Hard
syfy.us.description: New York City policeman John McClane is visiting his estranged wife and two daughters on Christmas Eve. He joins her at a holiday party in the headquarters of the Japanese-owned business she works for. But the festivities are interrupted by a group of terrorists who take over the exclusive high-rise, and everyone in it. Very soon McClane realizes that there's no one to save the hostages -- but him.

syfy.us.title: Die Hard 2
syfy.us.description: A year after his heroics in L.A., detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is mixed up in another terrorist plot, this time at Washington Dulles International Airport, where he is waiting for his wife (Bonnie Bedelia). That same night, South American politico and drug profiteer Ramon Esperanza (Franco Nero) is arriving in U.S. custody. McClane takes action when a treasonous ex-colonel (William Sadler) seizes control of the airport, threatening to crash every inbound flight unless Esperanza is freed.

syfy.us.title: Halloween
syfy.us.description: Nearly two decades after being committed to a mental institution for killing his stepfather and older sister, Michael Myers breaks out, intent on returning to the town of Haddonfield, Ill. He arrives in his hometown on Halloween with the indomitable purpose of hunting down his younger sister, Laurie. The only thing standing between Michael and a Halloween night of bloody carnage is psychologist Dr. Samuel Loomis.

syfy.us.description: A wealthy man devises an elaborate hoax to force three people to apologize for humiliating him earlier in his life.

syfy.us.title: The Forever Purge

Juan impresses the Tucker patriarch, Caleb, but that fuels the jealous anger of his son, Dylan. On the morning after the Purge, a masked gang of killers attacks the Tuckers, forcing both families to band together and fight back as the country spirals into chaos.

Caught in a high-speed chase, the two siblings must figure out a way to outrun the law while keeping their hostages alive.

syfywest.us.description: Modern National Guardsmen maneuvering at Little Big Horn find ominous signs of an impending Indian attack.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The Howling Man
syfywest.us.description: Taking refuge in a European monastery during a storm, a man hears someone howling and is told it's the Devil who is being held prisoner.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The Long Morrow
syfywest.us.description: An astronaut returns from a 30-year mission to find that his girlfriend hasn't aged at all.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The After Hours
syfywest.us.description: Marsha White goes to a department store to buy a gold thimble.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Printer's Devil
syfywest.us.description: A desperate newspaper editor hires the devil (Burgess Meredith) to save his failing business. With Patricia Crowley.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Mr. Garrity and the Graves
syfywest.us.description: A con man convinces the inhabitants of a Western town that he can raise the dead from the local cemetery.

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Black Leather Jackets
syfywest.us.description: Tough aliens from outer space try to poison the population of earth.

syfywest.us.title: Safety Not Guaranteed
syfywest.us.description: A disaffected magazine intern (Aubrey Plaza) befriends an unusual guy (Mark Duplass), who is looking for a partner to accompany him on a trip back through time. (movie) - 2012

syfywest.us.title: The Forever Purge
syfywest.us.description: Adela and her husband, Juan, live in Texas, where he works as a ranch hand for the wealthy Tucker family. Juan impresses the Tucker patriarch, Caleb, but that fuels the jealous anger of his son, Dylan. On the morning after the Purge, a masked gang of killers attacks the Tuckers, forcing both families to band together and fight back as the country spirals into chaos. (movie) - 2021

syfywest.us.title: Die Hard
syfywest.us.description: New York City policeman John McClane is visiting his estranged wife and two daughters on Christmas Eve. He joins her at a holiday party in the headquarters of the Japanese-owned business she works for. But the festivities are interrupted by a group of terrorists who take over the exclusive high-rise, and everyone in it. Very soon McClane realizes that there's no one to save the hostages -- but him. (movie) - 1988

talkingpictures.uk.title: Road Games
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1981. Thriller. Directed by Richard Franklin. Stars Jamie Lee Curtis, Stacy Keach & Marion Edward. A truck driver in Australia begins to suspect that a man is killing young women along his route.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Big Lift
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1950. War drama starring Montgomery Clift. In 1948 the Soviet Union blockades the allied sectors of Berlin, to bring the entire city under their control.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Glimpses - Far Away Places
talkingpictures.uk.description: Parkside Productions present The Malcolm Mitchell Group playing 'Far Away Places'. Directed by Roger Proudlock.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Come Back, Shame
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Cliff Robertson. Batman and Robin reckon something's up when Shame steals Grimaldi Smith's hot racing car in the middle of the Gotham City 500.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - It's How You Play the Game
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West, Cliff Robertson & Eric Shea. Shame goes to work on his final caper - the theft of four prize cattle worth over one million dollars.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Johnny On The Spot
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1954. Crime directed by Maclean Rogers. Johnny returns from a prison sentence to get the man who framed him.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Girdle of Gold
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1952. Comedy directed by Montgomery Tully and filmed at Nettlefold. Starring Esmond Knight and Maudie Edwards. A husband hides a fortune in his wife's girdle, only for the girdle to go 'missing'.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hell's Angels - 1930. War. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Howard Hughes. Stars Ben Lyon, James Hall & Jean Harlow. Epic war film following the lives of two dissimilar brothers as they join the Royal Flying Corps when war breaks out.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sussex Fortnight
talkingpictures.uk.description: Made in 1950. By bicycle with Raymond Glendenning to Arundel, Littlehampton and a horse show, ending with the Goodwood Cup.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Night Train to Paris - 1964. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Robert Douglas. Stars Leslie Nielsen & Aliza Gur. A retired spy agrees to a friend's request to deliver a tape to Paris and prevent it from falling into the wrong hands.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Buccaneers
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Instrument of War. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Andrew Keir & Charles Houston. Dan travels to Prisoner's Island to collect valuable cargo, however, the cargo is a single Scottish Highland Chief.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Young Land - 1959. Western. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ted Tetzlaff. Stars Patrick Wayne, Yvonne Craig & Dennis Hopper. American gunslinger kills a Mexican man. He is arrested and the Hispanic population wait for justice.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Oliver Twist - 1982. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Clive Donner. Stars George C. Scott, Tim Curry & Michael Hordern. The classic tale of an orphan boy who finds himself joining a band of thieves after escaping the orphanage.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Scales of Justice
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Infamous Conduct. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Dermot Walsh. A famous surgeon loses his license after a female patient accuses him of conduct unbecoming a physician.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rooms - Ted & Mrs. Fox: Part 1
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ted & Mrs Fox P1. Stars Russell Hunter, Madeline Smith and Maureen Pryor. In a world where nobody has the time to 'listen', people like Ted and Mrs Fox are lucky to find each other.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rooms - Ted & Mrs. Fox: Part 2
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ted & Mrs Fox P2. Stars Joyce Heron, Russell Hunter, Perry Balfour, Madeline Smith & Maureen Pryor. Mrs Fox and Ted are incurable romantics, clinging to memories of the past.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Out of Town
talkingpictures.uk.description: Fly Casting/The Log Splitter. 1986. Jack Hargreaves illustrates the technical advances in fly fishing. He then shows us his latest gadget for chopping logs for his wood burning stove.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dick Turpin - The Turncoat
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, David Daker & Forbes Collins. Spiker is ambushed whilst carrying a letter for Sir John Glutton, who then forces Dick Turpin to recover the message.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Van der Valk - Freedom in Amsterdam
talkingpictures.uk.description: Enemy. Stars Barry Foster, Joanna Dunham & Nigel Stock. When Van der Valk and his wife Arlette receive death threats, the detective finds himself looking for a mysterious Enemy. (Crime, Drama, Entertainment) - 2020

talkingpictures.uk.title: An Innocent Man
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1989. Crime Drama. Directed by Peter Yates. Stars Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham & Laila Robins. Two corrupt cops send an innocent man to prison, leading him to seek revenge on his release. (Crime, Drama, Thriller, Movie) - 1989

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Devil's Hand
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1961. Horror. Directed by William J. Hole Jr. Stars Linda Christian, Robert Alda & Ariadne Welter. A man, haunted by visions of a beautiful woman, winds up in a Satanic cult after meeting her. (Horror, Thriller, Movie) - 2014

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
tastemade.us.description: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
tastemade.us.description: It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
tastemade.us.description: It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Game Day
tastemade.us.description: Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. Game days aren't for dinner parties, but they are a day for some fan-favorite finger foods, especially those you can make in advance. Frankie makes three no-fuss appetizers.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Vintage
tastemade.us.description: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they'll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Eggscellent Techniques
tastemade.us.description: Frankie teaches several methods for cooking eggs; the scramble, the omelet, and the Benedict; learn to make them just the way one likes them.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Crunchy
tastemade.us.description: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Winter Is Here
tastemade.us.description: The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Struggle Soup
tastemade.us.description: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie's soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - 5-Ingredient Recipes
tastemade.us.description: These five-ingredient recipes are anything but boring; with a few pantry staples, these simple weeknight meals will be on the table in no time.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - No Kitchen No Problem
tastemade.us.description: Frankie shows us easy and inventive no-kitchen hacks for delicious struggle meals. No Kitchen? No problem.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Spice Is Nice
tastemade.us.description: Frankie shows us how to make a variety of homemade spice blends and tackles a challenge with a monster guest!

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Struggle Sandwich
tastemade.us.description: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin's, and Frankie's cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Mushroom Mania
tastemade.us.description: Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They're packed with nutritional value, and they're an affordable plant-based meat replacement. We'll learn about all things mushrooms and how to make some inventive, flavorful dishes.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Thanksgiving Dinner
tastemade.us.description: Thanksgiving dinner will be a breeze this year thanks to Frankie's struggle tips for a delicious holiday meal. From a simple turkey entrée to a new twist on a classic dessert, Frankie makes a feast without unstuffing his wallet.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Thanksgiving Leftovers
tastemade.us.description: SeriesTMSID: SH030064860000. Series Description: The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

tastemade.us.title: Thanksgiving HOT TAKE: Is Turkey actually the worst? - Forking Delicious: Top 10 Thanksgiving Dishes
tastemade.us.description: On this episode, we're talking turkey. That's right, it's time for Thanksgiving! Join our panel of thankful experts as they gather to offer their insights and opinions as we count down your top ten turkey day must-haves.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Mid-Century Poolside Retreat Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - The Floating Restaurant of Devon, United Kingdom
tastemadetravel.us.description: Fred travels to South Devon with chef and restaurateur Angela Hartnett. From Angela's all-time favourite restaurant in Dartmouth to an incredible floating café on the River Exe.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
tastemadetravel.us.description: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Desperately Seeking Santa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

themoviechannel.us.title: Internal Affairs
themoviechannel.us.description: In the Los Angeles Police Department, Officer Dennis Peck (Richard Gere) is a divisive figure, loved by those who are loyal to him and looked on with suspicion by others. His disreputable behavior and dubious finances arouse the suspicion of Internal Affairs, and Sgt. Raymond Avila (Andy Garcia) and his partner (Laurie Metcalf) are assigned to investigate. When a series of witnesses are murdered, Avila realizes his life is in danger, along with that of his wife (Nancy Travis).

themoviechannel.us.title: Cop Land
themoviechannel.us.description: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live.

themoviechannel.us.title: Machete Kills
themoviechannel.us.description: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done.

themoviechannel.us.title: Buddymoon
themoviechannel.us.description: After he is dumped at the altar, a former child star's best friend takes him on a backpacking trek in the remote mountains of Oregon.

themoviechannel.us.title: The Mechanic
themoviechannel.us.description: One of an elite group of assassins, Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) may be the best in the business. Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership.

themoviechannel.us.title: Hugo
themoviechannel.us.description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

themoviechannel.us.title: Terms of Endearment
themoviechannel.us.description: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children.

themoviechannel.us.title: Wakefield
themoviechannel.us.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned.

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

themoviechannel.us.title: Barron's Cove
themoviechannel.us.description: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (movie) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (movie) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Every Breath You Take
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family. (movie) - 2021

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Airport
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this large-ensemble disaster movie, Mel Bakersfeld (Burt Lancaster), the general manager of a Chicago-area airport, must contend with a massive snowstorm and other issues, both work-related and personal, while the troubled D.O. Guerrero (Van Heflin) threatens to blow up an airliner. As pilot Vernon Demerest (Dean Martin) attempts to calm Guerrero down and dissuade him from setting off explosives on the plane, tensions increase in the air and on the ground, and danger is imminent.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Field of Dreams
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Iowa farmer Ray hears a mysterious voice one night in his cornfield saying "If you build it, he will come," he feels the need to act. Despite taunts of lunacy, Ray builds a baseball diamond on his land, supported by his wife, Annie. Afterward, the ghosts of great players start emerging from the crops to play ball, led by "Shoeless" Joe Jackson. But, as Ray learns, this field of dreams is about much more than bringing former baseball greats out to play.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Atlantic City
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Sally Matthews (Susan Sarandon) leaves her Canadian home to relocate to Atlantic City, she aspires to a prosperous career in the gambling industry. With her criminal husband (Robert Joy) on her trail, however, it appears that she can't escape from trouble, until she finds an unlikely savior in Lou Pascal (Burt Lancaster), an aging small-time mobster. By becoming involved with Sally, Lou finds a way to achieve the success he's dreamed of, but his plan may endanger both their lives.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ulzana's Raid
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When word arrives that Apache warrior Ulzana has assembled a war party and left the reservation, the United States Army pegs veteran tracker McIntosh (Burt Lancaster) and Apache Ke-Ni-Tay (Jorge Luke) to lead a young, prejudiced lieutenant's (Bruce Davison) troops to find Ulzana. Outmaneuvered and unfamiliar with the terrain, the cavalry struggles to stop the long-mistreated and raging Apaches from destroying everything in their path in what initially seem like senseless acts of violence.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Local Hero
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Up-and-coming Houston oil executive Mac MacIntyre gets more than he bargained for when a seemingly simple business trip to Scotland changes his outlook on life. Sent by his colorful boss to the small village of Ferness, Mac is looking to quickly buy out the townspeople, so his company can build a new refinery. But after a taste of country life Mac begins to question whether he is on the right side of this transaction.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lord Jeff
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In London, orphan Geoff Bramer (Freddie Bartholomew) helps thieves Doris (Gale Sondergaard) and Jim (George Zucco) with a racket stealing from jewelry stores. Once apprehended, Geoff is sent to a mariner's academy run by kindly headmaster Capt. Briggs (Charles Coburn) that houses orphaned boys. Geoff resists the school's discipline and runs away, but school leader Terry O'Mulvaney (Mickey Rooney) brings him back, then refuses to tell on him -- prompting Geoff to reconsider his attitude.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweethearts
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Happily married New York City stage actors Ernest Lane (Nelson Eddy) and Gwen Marlowe (Jeanette MacDonald) are stars of a successful Broadway production. However, when the couple is wooed by Hollywood, the team behind the play, including theater producer Felix Lehman (Frank Morgan), launches a scheme to prevent their move to the West Coast. While the deception works, it also causes the charming pair to split. Can Ernest and Gwen see through the lies and rekindle their love?

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Christmas Carol
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Crotchety miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Reginald Owen) hates Christmas and mistreats his long-suffering employee, devoted family man Bob Cratchit (Gene Lockhart). But a visit from the ghost of his former business partner Jacob Marley (Leo G. Carroll) and three Christmas spirits (Lionel Braham, Ann Rutherford, D'Arcy Corrigan) might convince him to change his ways and become more kindhearted. This adaptation of the Charles Dickens classic became a holiday staple for decades.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Goodbye, Mr. Chips
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Young schoolteacher Charles Edward Chipping (Robert Donat) imposes strict discipline on his young charges at a Victorian-era English public school, becoming a fearsome presence on the campus grounds. But the love of spirited young suffragette Katherine Ellis (Greer Garson) brings the Latin instructor out of his shell and makes him a beloved campus institution into the 20th century and through the shattering violence of World War I. The film is based on the best-selling novel by James Hilton.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Andy Hardy Gets Spring Fever
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the small town of Carvel, Judge James Hardy (Lewis Stone) learns from a chemist and promoter that a plot of land always considered worthless is actually rich in bauxite, a mineral used to make aluminum. After verifying the claim, the judge urges his friends and neighbors to invest in the land with him. Meanwhile, the judge's teenage son, Andy (Mickey Rooney), falls for a new teacher after getting dumped by his girlfriend. Both the judge and Andy learn that things aren't what they seem. (movie) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Yank at Eton
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dismayed when his mother marries Englishman Roger Carlton (Ian Hunter), teenager Tim Dennis (Mickey Rooney) chafes at leaving America and his college football dreams to move to England. His mother convinces Tim to try Eton College for six months, but once there he clashes with the traditions of the conservative students -- who are led by Roger's son, school head boy Peter (Freddie Bartholomew). When Tim's girlfriend shows an interest in Peter, Tim's response nearly causes disaster. (movie) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: National Velvet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Velvet Brown (Elizabeth Taylor), an equine-loving 12-year-old living in rural Sussex, becomes the owner of a rambunctious horse, she decides to train it for England's Grand National race. Aided by former jockey Mi Taylor (Mickey Rooney) and encouraged by her family, the determined Velvet gets her steed, affectionately called "The Pie," ready for the big day. However, a last-minute problem arises with the jockey and an unexpected rider must step in as a replacement. (movie) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Fortunes of Captain Blood
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Following his banishment from England for aiding an injured enemy, physician Peter Blood (Louis Hayward) resorts to piracy, becoming captain of a notorious crew of buccaneers. Sent to capture Blood is the Marquis de Riconete (George Macready), a brutal man willing to do whatever it takes to bring in the wanted swashbuckler. After Riconete finally catches Blood's crew on an island, Blood must go incognito to rescue his men, all with the help of Riconete's niece Isabelita (Patricia Medina). (movie) - 1950

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates.

documentary+.us.title: Alter Egos
documentary+.us.description: S01 E01 Setting the Stage We follow a collection of veteran and up-and-coming cosplayers as they prepare to attend a variety of conventions.

documentary+.us.title: Alter Egos
documentary+.us.description: S01 E02 Con Crunch In this episode, our cosplayers discuss their early days in the wild west of conventions-from scrappy crafter to professional cosplayer. Plus, their journey of starting a business and making the nerve-wracking jump from hobby to career.

documentary+.us.title: Alter Egos
documentary+.us.description: S01 E03 CosFamous Join veteran cosplayers for an inside look at their home studios and discover how they evolved from passionate convention attendees to honored guests and hosts of panels, contests and workshops.

documentary+.us.title: Alter Egos
documentary+.us.description: S01 E04 Iterations We are all welcome here; cosplaying is all about trials and tribulations; failure is how you become a better cosplayer; the inclusive cosplay community lifts us up and supports us by giving us the freedom to make mistakes so we can hone our craft.

documentary+.us.title: Alter Egos
documentary+.us.description: S01 E05 Wrangling Superheroes It's really all about the contests; cosplayers spend months, sometimes years, artfully crafting and building their costumes; it's more than just the glitz and glamour we see in the end.

documentary+.us.title: Alter Egos
documentary+.us.description: S01 E06 Augmented Reality Our cosplayers talk about overcoming stigmas and embracing their truest selves; it's the culmination of years of work, coming together in workshops, contests and parades.

documentary+.us.title: True Crime Files: The Missing Child Cover-Up
documentary+.us.description: Examining the disappearance and death of Taylor Williams and the investigation that follows. Through interrogation footage, investigative records and courtroom developments, the film traces how a suspected cover-up unraveled and revealed the truth.

documentary+.us.title: True Crime Files: The Shocking Case of Brian Cohee Jr
documentary+.us.description: Brian Cohee Jr. is a 19-year-old from Grand Junction, Colorado, who gains national attention in 2021 after being arrested for murder. Police discover that Cohee had killed 69-year-old Warren Barnes, a homeless man, before dismembering his body.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E22 750 Sq. Ft. Tiny On-Deck Steve and Melissa build a contemporary and colorful home that gives everyone the privacy they'd like while being constrained to less space than what they're used to.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: Size Doesn't Matter: The Best of Tiny Houses John Weisbarth celebrates the most awe-inspiring solutions in tiny living; from an eco-friendly studio to a refurbished silo; proof that size doesn't matter.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: Tiny Haunted House The hauntrepreneurs and the staff at Blue Moon Rising will create a magical collection of three tiny haunted houses. They will prove that Tiny can still be terrifying!

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S05 E03 Tiny House Builders Can't Jump John and Zack travel to sunny Orlando, Fla., where high school basketball coach Dave and his wife, Mickie, are going tiny so they'll have more money to pay for their daughter's college tuition.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S01 E01 Luxury Micro Cabins in Wisconsin Gus and Kyle crave a tiny, vacation home along the shores of Lake Superior in Northern Wisconsin, where they can escape their hectic lifestyle to enjoy the natural surroundings and quality time with each other.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S01 E02 A Tiny Bite of the Big Apple Jacqueline and her husband David want to raise their growing family in the city they love, but buying a tiny space is an all out survival tactic.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S01 E03 Portable Micro Homes in Portland Eric Cavizo, an eccentric barbershop owner, wants to buy his very first home that he can share with his seven-year-old son, Kaden; Eric is having a tough time trimming down his options.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S01 E04 Tiny Beach Bungalows in Florida Empty nesters Glen and Lawson are looking for the perfect, tiny beachside getaway for themselves and their family; finding a tiny beach bungalow that accommodates seven and fulfills the other items on their wish list will be quite the challenge.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting

unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E08 Incredible Survivors A look at how some people live through the impossible such as plane crashes, freezing temperatures, or performing superhuman feats while in danger; remarkable tales of human survival force others to reconsider what is known about the will to live.

unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E12 Deadly Cults Many of the world's deadliest cults venture down dark, dangerous rabbit holes of twisted ideologies, with deadly dances, manipulation, mass suicides, and murder.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained

(Biography, Documentary, Art, Arts/crafts) - 2012

BBC4.uk.title: Remembers.. - Sandy Welch Remembers... Our Mutual Friend
BBC4.uk.description: Acclaimed screenwriter Sandy Welch looks back on her adaptation of Charles Dickens's final novel, Our Mutual Friend, as she recounts the challenges in bringing this multilayered gothic story to life. The 1998 drama featured a slew of renowned actors, including Anna Friel, Keeley Hawes, Paul McGann and David Morrissey, and drew praise from critics at the time for its dark, gritty storytelling, winning Sandy a BAFTA for Best Drama Serial of the year. (Documentary) - 2026

BBC4.uk.title: Our Mutual Friend
BBC4.uk.description: The Boffins inherit a fortune when John Harmon, the only son and heir of their old employer, apparently drowns. Bella Wilfer, his wife-to-be by terms of old Harmon's will, goes into mourning though she has never met her fiancé. The Boffins hire a very capable but mysterious young man as secretary, John Rokesmith, whose keen interest in Bella holds the secret to his true identity.
